metadata.note: Query content only. Upstream validation does not establish validation in the dashboard tenant. No schedules or alarms are deployed.

rules.name: Accessibility Features Backdoor
rules.description: Detects replacement of accessibility programs (sethc, utilman, osk) with cmd.exe for pre-login access.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Command Line' like '*sethc.exe*' or 'Command Line' like '*utilman.exe*' or 'Command Line' like '*osk.exe*' or 'Command Line' like '*narrator.exe*' or 'Command Line' like '*magnify.exe*')) and (('Command Line' like '*copy*' or 'Command Line' like '*move*' or 'Command Line' like '*ren*' or 'Command Line' like '*reg*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Account Access Removal
rules.description: Detects deletion or disabling of user accounts which may indicate an attempt to lock out legitimate users.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Process Name' like '*\\net.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\net1.exe') and ('Command Line' like '*user*' and 'Command Line' like '*/active:no*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Active Setup Persistence
rules.description: Detects creation of Active Setup entries in the registry for per-user persistence.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Command Line' like '*Active Setup*' and 'Command Line' like '*StubPath*')))
false_positives: Legitimate Active Setup entries from software installers
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: AD Enumeration via ADFind
rules.description: Detects usage of AdFind.exe for Active Directory enumeration and reconnaissance.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (('Process Name' like '*\\AdFind.exe'))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: ADCS ESC1: Subject Alternative Name Abuse via Certipy/Certify
rules.description: Detects ADCS ESC1 abuse where an attacker requests a certificate from a vulnerable template that allows enrollee-supplied subject and uses an alternate UPN (SAN) to impersonate a privileged account. Certipy and Certify expose this via the 'req' action with -upn/-template/-altname. In GOAD this is run against the ESC1 template on the CA to impersonate a Domain Admin.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Command Line' like '*certipy*' or 'Command Line' like '*Certify.exe*' or 'Command Line' like '*Certify *')) and (('Command Line' like '*req*' or 'Command Line' like '*request*')) and (('Command Line' like '*-upn*' or 'Command Line' like '*/altname*' or 'Command Line' like '*-altname*' or 'Command Line' like '*subject*' or 'Command Line' like '*-sid*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: ADCS ESC4: Certificate Template ACL Modification via Certipy
rules.description: Detects ESC4 abuse where an attacker with write access to a certificate template reconfigures it to become ESC1-vulnerable (enrollee-supplied SAN, client-auth EKU). Certipy 'template' with -write/-save performs this template takeover before requesting an impersonation certificate.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Command Line' like '*certipy*' and 'Command Line' like '*template*')) and (('Command Line' like '*-write*' or 'Command Line' like '*-save-old*' or 'Command Line' like '*-configuration*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: ADCS ESC6: EDITF_ATTRIBUTESUBJECTALTNAME2 Flag Enabled via Certutil
rules.description: Detects enabling of the EDITF_ATTRIBUTESUBJECTALTNAME2 policy flag on an Enterprise CA (ESC6). When set, any requester can specify an arbitrary SAN on any certificate request, allowing domain-wide impersonation. Set via 'certutil -setreg policy\EditFlags'. GOAD demonstrates this on the SRV03 CA.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Command Line' like '*setreg*' and 'Command Line' like '*EditFlags*')) or (('Command Line' like '*EDITF_ATTRIBUTESUBJECTALTNAME2*' or 'Command Line' like '*ATTRIBUTESUBJECTALTNAME2*')))
false_positives: Legitimate CA policy administration (rare; should be change-controlled)
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: ADCS ESC8: NTLM Relay to Certificate Web Enrollment
rules.description: Detects ESC8 attacks relaying coerced NTLM authentication to the ADCS HTTP web-enrollment endpoint (certsrv) to obtain a certificate for a DC or privileged account. Indicators include Certipy 'relay' mode and ntlmrelayx targeting /certsrv/certfnsh.asp. In GOAD this is chained with PetitPotam.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Command Line' like '*certipy relay*' or 'Command Line' like '*-target http*' or 'Command Line' like '*certsrv*' or 'Command Line' like '*certfnsh.asp*' or 'Command Line' like '*CertificateWebEnrollment*' or 'Command Line' like '*-template DomainController*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: AdminSDHolder ACL Modification for Persistence
rules.description: Detects modification of the AdminSDHolder container ACL (or dsacls against it) to plant a backdoor that SDProp re-applies to all protected groups every 60 minutes, granting durable privileged access to Domain Admins and similar.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (('Command Line' like '*AdminSDHolder*') and (('Command Line' like '*dsacls*' or 'Command Line' like '*Add-DomainObjectAcl*' or 'Command Line' like '*/G *' or 'Command Line' like '*GenericAll*' or 'Command Line' like '*Set-Acl*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Alternate Data Stream Execution
rules.description: Detects execution of payloads hidden in NTFS Alternate Data Streams.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Command Line' like '*.exe:*' or 'Command Line' like '*.dll:*' or 'Command Line' like '*.txt:*' or 'Command Line' like '*.ps1:*' or 'Command Line' like '*.bat:*' or 'Command Line' like '*.vbs:*' or 'Command Line' like '*.js:*')))
false_positives: Legitimate use of alternate data streams by backup software
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: AlwaysInstallElevated Exploitation
rules.description: Detects exploitation of AlwaysInstallElevated policy for privilege escalation via MSI.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (('Process Name' like '*\\msiexec.exe' and ('Command Line' like '*/quiet*' or 'Command Line' like '*/qn*')) and not ((User = 'SYSTEM' or User = 'NT AUTHORITY\\SYSTEM')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: AMSI Bypass via PowerShell Reflection
rules.description: Detects PowerShell reflection techniques used to bypass AMSI by patching the AmsiScanBuffer function.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Command Line' like '*System.Management.Automation*' and 'Command Line' like '*amsi*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: API Endpoint Unauthorized Access Attempts
rules.description: Detects unauthorized access attempts to API endpoints (401/403 responses). May indicate API key brute force, token manipulation, or broken access control. OWASP A01:2021 Broken Access Control.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'OCI Load Balancer Access Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Load Balancer Access Logs') and ((('Request URL' like '*/api/*' or 'Request URL' like '*/v1/*' or 'Request URL' like '*/v2/*' or 'Request URL' like '*/graphql*' or 'Request URL' like '*/rest/*')) and (('Response Code' = '401' or 'Response Code' = '403')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: APM: SQL Injection Attack in Request
rules.description: Detects SQL injection payloads inside APM-instrumented application requests. Matches UNION SELECT, OR 1=1, time-based blind (SLEEP), boolean-based, error-based (EXTRACTVALUE), and stacked-query patterns appearing in Request URL.
rules.oci_query: 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs' and (('Request URL' like '*UNION SELECT*' or 'Request URL' like '*UNION%20SELECT*' or 'Request URL' like '*UNION+SELECT*' or 'Request URL' like '*union select*' or 'Request URL' like '*union%20select*') or ('Request URL' like '*OR 1=1*' or 'Request URL' like '*OR%201%3D1*' or 'Request URL' like '*%27%20OR%201%3D1*' or 'Request URL' like '*AND 1=1*') or ('Request URL' like '*SLEEP(*' or 'Request URL' like '*BENCHMARK(*' or 'Request URL' like '*WAITFOR DELAY*') or ('Request URL' like '*EXTRACTVALUE(*' or 'Request URL' like '*UPDATEXML(*') or ('Request URL' like '*INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES*' or 'Request URL' like '*INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS*') or ('Request URL' like '*; DROP TABLE*'))
false_positives: Documentation pages or knowledge-base articles containing SQL examples in URL query strings
Internal red-team / sqlmap penetration tests against staging APM-instrumented apps
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: AppInit DLLs Persistence
rules.description: Detects modification of AppInit_DLLs registry value to inject DLLs into every process that loads User32.dll.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Command Line' like '*AppInit_DLLs*' and 'Command Line' like '*reg*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Application Shimming for Persistence
rules.description: Detects creation of application compatibility shims using sdbinst.exe.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (('Process Name' like '*\\sdbinst.exe'))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: AppLocker Policy Bypass via MSHTML
rules.description: Detects MSHTA or similar MSHTML-based execution paths used to bypass AppLocker policies.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (('Process Name' like '*\\mshta.exe' and ('Command Line' like '*javascript:*' or 'Command Line' like '*vbscript:*' or 'Command Line' like '*http*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: APM: Browser Attack to WAF Block Correlation
rules.description: Summary table joining browser-side attack telemetry from SOC Application Logs with the WAF signal that flagged the same Trace ID. Hosts a count of how many traces fired both an APM detection and a WAF block, so the SOC can prove cross-tier defence-in-depth coverage.
rules.oci_query: 'Log Source' in ('SOC Application Logs', 'SOC WAF Security Logs') and 'Trace ID' != null | stats count as Events, distinctcount('Log Source') as DistinctTiers, distinctcount('Service Name') as Services by 'Trace ID' | where DistinctTiers > 1 | sort -Events
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: APM: Browser Fingerprinting via Canvas/WebGL/AudioContext
rules.description: Detects browser fingerprinting techniques using Canvas API, WebGL parameters, AudioContext, and other APIs commonly used to uniquely identify browsers. Excessive fingerprinting API calls indicate tracking scripts or reconnaissance.
rules.oci_query: 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs' and (( (('Span Attributes' like '*canvas.toDataURL*' or 'Span Attributes' like '*toBlob*' or 'Span Attributes' like '*getImageData*')) and (('Span Attributes' like '*webgl.getParameter*' or 'Span Attributes' like '*WEBGL_debug_renderer_info*' or 'Span Attributes' like '*getExtension*')) ) or ( (('Span Attributes' like '*AudioContext*' or 'Span Attributes' like '*OfflineAudioContext*' or 'Span Attributes' like '*createOscillator*')) and (('Span Attributes' like '*navigator.plugins*' or 'Span Attributes' like '*navigator.languages*' or 'Span Attributes' like '*screen.colorDepth*' or 'Span Attributes' like '*navigator.hardwareConcurrency*')) ) or ( (('Span Attributes' like '*canvas.toDataURL*' or 'Span Attributes' like '*toBlob*' or 'Span Attributes' like '*getImageData*')) and (('Span Attributes' like '*AudioContext*' or 'Span Attributes' like '*OfflineAudioContext*' or 'Span Attributes' like '*createOscillator*')) )) | stats count as FingerprintAttempts by 'Client IP', 'User Agent', 'Service Name' | sort -FingerprintAttempts
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: APM: Clickjacking - Missing Frame Protection Headers
rules.description: Detects HTTP responses missing X-Frame-Options or Content-Security-Policy frame-ancestors directives, indicating vulnerability to clickjacking attacks. Monitors APM response headers for missing security controls.
rules.oci_query: 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs' and (('Response Code' = '200' and 'Content Type' like '*text/html*') and not (('Response Headers' like '*X-Frame-Options*' or 'Response Headers' like '*frame-ancestors*'))) | stats count as MissingHeaders by 'Request URL', 'Service Name' | sort -MissingHeaders
false_positives: Public pages intentionally designed to be embeddable
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: APM: CSRF Token Missing or Invalid on State-Changing Request
rules.description: Detects HTTP POST/PUT/DELETE requests to state-changing endpoints that lack CSRF tokens or have invalid tokens, indicating potential Cross-Site Request Forgery. Uses APM span attributes to detect missing security headers.
rules.oci_query: 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs' and ((('HTTP Method' = 'POST' or 'HTTP Method' = 'PUT' or 'HTTP Method' = 'DELETE' or 'HTTP Method' = 'PATCH')) and (not ('Referrer' like '*')) and not (('Request URL' like '*/api/health*' or 'Request URL' like '*/api/status*' or 'Request URL' like '*/login*' or 'Request URL' like '*/oauth*' or 'Request URL' like '*/webhook*'))) | stats count as Violations by 'Request URL', 'HTTP Method', 'Client IP', 'Service Name' | sort -Violations
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: APM: DOM-Based Attack via Dangerous JavaScript APIs
rules.description: Detects DOM-based attacks using dangerous JavaScript APIs observed in browser telemetry spans. Monitors for document.cookie access, eval() calls, innerHTML manipulation, and location/hash-based injection in OpenTelemetry browser spans.
rules.oci_query: 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs' and ((('Span Attributes' like '*document.cookie*' or 'Span Attributes' like '*document.domain*')) or (('Span Attributes' like '*eval(*' or 'Span Attributes' like '*Function(*' or 'Span Attributes' like '*setTimeout(*' or 'Span Attributes' like '*setInterval(*')) or (('Span Attributes' like '*.innerHTML*' or 'Span Attributes' like '*.outerHTML*' or 'Span Attributes' like '*document.write*' or 'Span Attributes' like '*insertAdjacentHTML*')) or (('Span Attributes' like '*location.hash*' or 'Span Attributes' like '*location.search*' or 'Span Attributes' like '*window.name*' or 'Span Attributes' like '*document.referrer*'))) | stats count as Attacks by 'Request URL', 'Client IP', 'User Agent', 'Service Name' | sort -Attacks
false_positives: Legitimate SPA frameworks using innerHTML for rendering
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: APM: Octo Demo API Gateway Edge Decisions
rules.description: API Gateway edge-policy, quota, auth, and backend decisions captured by the Octo attack lab and correlated to the same Attack ID, Request ID, and Trace ID used by APM spans and application logs.
rules.oci_query: 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs' and 'Service Namespace' = 'octo' and 'Attack ID' != null and 'API Gateway Request ID' != null | stats count as Events, distinctcount('Trace ID') as Traces, unique('API Gateway Policy Decision') as Decisions, unique('API Gateway Threat Signal') as ThreatSignals by 'Attack ID', 'API Gateway Action', 'API Gateway Route', 'Security Severity' | sort -Events
false_positives: Admin-triggered attack-lab simulations or API Gateway policy tests in demo compartments.
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: APM: Octo Demo Attack Path Link
rules.description: Link analysis for the Octo attack-lab path. Groups attack stages, traces, and spans into a single investigation canvas with custom tiles for the number of attacks, events, traces, and stages.
rules.oci_query: 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs' and 'Service Namespace' = 'octo' and 'Attack ID' != null and 'Trace ID' != null | link span = 5minute 'Attack ID', 'Attack Stage', 'Trace ID', 'Span ID' | eventstats distinctcount('Attack ID') as Attacks, sum(Count) as Events, distinctcount('Trace ID') as Traces, distinctcount('Attack Stage') as Stages
false_positives: Expected attack-lab runs from the admin console during a workshop or demo.
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: APM: Octo Demo Attack Timeline
rules.description: Chronological attack-lab events from the Octo APM demo, keyed by Attack ID, Run ID, Request ID, Trace ID, and Span ID so operators can pivot from security logs into APM spans.
rules.oci_query: 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs' and 'Service Namespace' = 'octo' and 'Attack ID' != null | sort Time | fields Time, 'Attack ID', 'Run ID', 'Attack Stage', 'Security Severity', 'MITRE Technique ID', 'Service Name', 'Workflow Step', 'Request ID', 'Trace ID', 'Span ID', 'Instance OCID', 'Payment Redirect URL', msg
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: APM: Octo Demo Attack Trace Correlation
rules.description: Trace-level rollup of attack-lab evidence. Shows which Attack ID and Run ID have spans, MITRE stages, payment redirect evidence, and compromised VM evidence on the same Trace ID.
rules.oci_query: 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs' and 'Service Namespace' = 'octo' and 'Attack ID' != null and 'Trace ID' != null | stats count as Events, distinctcount('Span ID') as Spans, unique('Attack Stage') as Stages, unique('MITRE Technique ID') as Techniques, unique('Payment Redirect URL') as Redirects, unique('Compromised VM') as CompromisedVMs by 'Attack ID', 'Run ID', 'Trace ID', 'Service Name' | sort -Events
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: APM: Octo Demo Compromised VM Pivots
rules.description: Compromised VM and process evidence from the Octo attack lab, including OSQuery findings, instance OCIDs, host roles, and process command lines.
rules.oci_query: 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs' and 'Service Namespace' = 'octo' and 'Attack ID' != null and 'Compromised VM' != null | stats count as Events, distinctcount('Trace ID') as Traces, unique('Process Command Line') as Commands, unique('OSQuery Query') as OSQueryQueries by 'Compromised VM', 'Instance OCID', 'Host Role', 'OSQuery Finding' | sort -Events
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: APM: Octo Demo Database Spans
rules.description: Database-related APM spans for octo-apm-demo, grouped by target, span name, slow request flag, and error type.
rules.oci_query: 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs' and 'Service Namespace' = 'octo' and ('Service Name' = 'octo-apm-demo' or 'APM Domain' = 'octo-apm-demo') and 'DB Target' != null | stats count as DBSpans, distinctcount('Trace ID') as Traces, unique('DB Elapsed ms') as LatencyMs by 'DB Target', 'DB Connection Name', 'Span Name', 'Error Type' | sort -DBSpans
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: APM: Octo Demo Error Logs by Span
rules.description: Error and warning logs for octo-apm-demo grouped by severity, error type, span name, and trace. Use this to jump from a failed log line to the span that produced it.
rules.oci_query: 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs' and 'Service Namespace' = 'octo' and ('Service Name' = 'octo-apm-demo' or 'APM Domain' = 'octo-apm-demo') and 'Severity Level' in ('ERROR', 'WARN', 'WARNING') | stats count as Events, distinctcount('Trace ID') as Traces by 'Severity Level', 'Error Type', 'Span Name', 'Response Code' | sort -Events
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: APM: Octo Demo Java Sidecar Error Correlation
rules.description: Java APM sidecar and payment-gateway error evidence correlated with Octo checkout and attack-lab traces. Highlights the Java path, error type, status code, and workflow step that should be investigated in APM Trace Explorer.
rules.oci_query: 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs' and 'Service Namespace' = 'octo' and ('Java APM Path' != null or 'Java APM Error Type' != null) | stats count as Events, distinctcount('Trace ID') as Traces, unique('Java APM Latency ms') as LatencyMs, unique('Response Code') as Statuses by 'Java APM Path', 'Java APM Error Type', 'Service Name', 'Workflow Step' | sort -Events
false_positives: Synthetic payment-gateway timeout and SQL-error simulations triggered by the admin demo console.
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: APM: Octo Demo Metric Samples
rules.description: Metric sample inventory for octo-apm-demo. Displays metric names, values, units, and routes as parsed from SOC Application Logs.
rules.oci_query: 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs' and 'Service Namespace' = 'octo' and ('Service Name' = 'octo-apm-demo' or 'APM Domain' = 'octo-apm-demo') and 'Metric Name' != null | stats count as Samples, unique('Metric Unit') as Units, unique('Metric Value') as Values, distinctcount('Trace ID') as Traces by 'Metric Name', 'Service Name', 'Workflow ID', 'Workflow Step' | sort -Samples
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: APM: Octo Demo OSQuery Host Evidence
rules.description: Host-level OSQuery findings emitted by the Octo attack lab, grouped by compromised host, instance OCID, query name, and severity so investigators can pivot from APM trace context to VM evidence.
rules.oci_query: 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs' and 'Service Namespace' = 'octo' and 'Attack ID' != null and 'OSQuery Query' != null | stats count as Findings, distinctcount('Trace ID') as Traces, unique('OSQuery Finding') as FindingSamples, unique('OSQuery SQL') as QuerySQL by 'Host Name', 'Instance OCID', 'OSQuery Query', 'Security Severity' | sort -Findings
false_positives: Expected host-evidence records when a demo operator runs the attack-lab workflow.
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: APM: Octo Demo Payment Threats
rules.description: Payment interception and redirect signals emitted by the Octo attack lab. Keeps only demo-safe payment metadata such as provider, status, brand, last4, risk score, and redirect URL.
rules.oci_query: 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs' and 'Service Namespace' = 'octo' and 'Attack ID' != null and ('Payment Interception' != null or 'Payment Redirect' != null or 'Payment Redirect URL' != null) | stats count as Events, distinctcount('Trace ID') as Traces, unique('Payment Risk Score') as RiskScores, unique('Payment Card Last4') as CardLast4 by 'Attack ID', 'Run ID', 'Payment Provider', 'Payment Redirect URL' | sort -Events
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: APM: Octo Demo RED Metrics
rules.description: Request, error, and duration-oriented telemetry for the Octo APM demo application. Groups metric samples by service, route, and response code so operators can find request volume, error concentration, and slow-path symptoms.
rules.oci_query: 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs' and 'Service Namespace' = 'octo' and ('Service Name' = 'octo-apm-demo' or 'APM Domain' = 'octo-apm-demo') and 'Metric Name' in ('http.server.duration', 'http.server.requests', 'apm.service.errors', 'http.server.duration.p95', 'apm.span.duration') | stats count as Samples, distinctcount('Trace ID') as Traces, distinctcount('Span ID') as Spans by 'Metric Name', 'Service Name', 'Workflow ID', 'Workflow Step' | sort -Samples
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: APM: Octo Demo Request and Error Timeline
rules.description: Timeline of octo-apm-demo application events by severity, suitable for spotting bursts of warnings, errors, and normal request flow.
rules.oci_query: 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs' and 'Service Namespace' = 'octo' and ('Service Name' = 'octo-apm-demo' or 'APM Domain' = 'octo-apm-demo') | timestats span = 5minute count as Events by 'Severity Level'
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: APM: Octo Demo API Gateway Threat Detection Rule
rules.description: Scheduled-rule-safe count of Octo API Gateway threat decisions tied to an attack ID and trace.
rules.oci_query: 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs' and 'Service Namespace' = 'octo' and 'Attack ID' != null and 'API Gateway Threat Signal' != null | stats count as ApiGatewayThreatEvents by 'Attack ID', 'Trace ID', 'API Gateway Threat Signal'
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: APM: Octo Demo Compromised VM Detection Rule
rules.description: Scheduled-rule-safe count of compromised VM evidence correlated to Octo attack IDs.
rules.oci_query: 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs' and 'Service Namespace' = 'octo' and 'Attack ID' != null and 'Compromised VM' != null | stats count as CompromisedVmEvents by 'Attack ID', 'Compromised VM', 'Host Role'
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: APM: Octo Demo Java Payment Error Detection Rule
rules.description: Scheduled-rule-safe count of Java APM sidecar payment errors for Octo checkout traces.
rules.oci_query: 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs' and 'Service Namespace' = 'octo' and 'Java APM Error Type' != null | stats count as JavaPaymentErrorEvents by 'Java APM Error Type', 'Trace ID', 'Response Code'
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: APM: Octo Demo Payment Interception Detection Rule
rules.description: Scheduled-rule-safe count of payment interception signals correlated to an Octo attack trace.
rules.oci_query: 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs' and 'Service Namespace' = 'octo' and 'Attack ID' != null and 'Payment Interception' != null | stats count as PaymentInterceptionEvents by 'Attack ID', 'Trace ID', 'Payment Provider'
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: APM: Octo Demo Payment Redirect Detection Rule
rules.description: Scheduled-rule-safe count of suspicious payment redirect signals correlated to an Octo attack trace.
rules.oci_query: 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs' and 'Service Namespace' = 'octo' and 'Attack ID' != null and 'Payment Redirect URL' != null | stats count as PaymentRedirectEvents by 'Attack ID', 'Trace ID', 'Payment Redirect URL'
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: APM: Octo Demo Span Latency Hotspots
rules.description: Span-level rollup for octo-apm-demo. Shows which span names, DB targets, slow request flags, and error types concentrate the most events.
rules.oci_query: 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs' and 'Service Namespace' = 'octo' and ('Service Name' = 'octo-apm-demo' or 'APM Domain' = 'octo-apm-demo') and 'Span ID' != null | stats count as Spans, distinctcount('Trace ID') as Traces, unique('DB Elapsed ms') as DBLatencyMs by 'Span Name', 'Workflow ID', 'Workflow Step', 'Error Type' | sort -Spans
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: APM: Octo Demo Span Link Analysis
rules.description: Link analysis for octo-apm-demo spans. Groups events by Trace ID, Span ID, Parent Span ID, and Span Name to make parent-child span correlation visible in the dashboard.
rules.oci_query: 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs' and 'Service Namespace' = 'octo' and ('Service Name' = 'octo-apm-demo' or 'APM Domain' = 'octo-apm-demo' or 'Attack ID' != null) and 'Trace ID' != null | link span = 5minute 'Trace ID', 'Span ID', 'Parent Span ID', 'Span Name' | eventstats distinctcount('Trace ID') as Traces, sum(Count) as Events, distinctcount('Span ID') as Spans, distinctcount('Parent Span ID') as Parents
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: APM: Octo Demo Trace Investigation Tiles
rules.description: A link-and-tiles investigation view for Octo APM traces. It groups logs, spans, attack evidence, API Gateway edge signals, Java errors, DB spans, and payment redirect indicators by Trace ID so analysts can move from APM Trace Explorer into Log Analytics without losing context.
rules.oci_query: 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs' and 'Service Namespace' = 'octo' and 'Trace ID' != null and ('Service Name' = 'octo-apm-demo' or 'APM Domain' = 'octo-apm-demo' or 'Attack ID' != null or 'Java APM Path' != null or 'API Gateway Threat Signal' != null or 'Payment Redirect URL' != null) | link span = 5minute 'Trace ID', 'Service Name', 'Span ID', 'Attack Stage' | eventstats distinctcount('Trace ID') as Traces, sum(Count) as Events, distinctcount('Service Name') as Services, distinctcount('Span ID') as Spans, distinctcount('Attack Stage') as Stages
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: APM: Octo Demo Trace to Log Correlation
rules.description: Correlates octo-apm-demo logs and span context by Trace ID. Use this table to pivot from a trace to its spans, routes, response codes, and error types.
rules.oci_query: 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs' and 'Service Namespace' = 'octo' and ('Service Name' = 'octo-apm-demo' or 'APM Domain' = 'octo-apm-demo' or 'Attack ID' != null) and 'Trace ID' != null | stats count as Events, distinctcount('Span ID') as Spans, unique('Error Type') as Errors, unique('Attack Stage') as AttackStages by 'Trace ID', 'Workflow ID', 'Workflow Step', 'Service Name' | sort -Events
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: APM: OWASP Attack Volume by Service
rules.description: Sunburst nesting Service Name inside Attack Type. Operators can compare which application surfaces face which OWASP categories most frequently and drill outward from a tactic slice to the affected service.
rules.oci_query: 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs' and 'Attack Type' != null | stats count as Events by 'Attack Type', 'Service Name' | sort -Events
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: APM: Session Hijacking - Rapid Session Changes
rules.description: Detects rapid session ID changes within a single trace or from a single IP, indicating potential session hijacking, session fixation, or cookie theft. Multiple distinct session IDs per source within a short window is anomalous.
rules.oci_query: 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs' and (('Span Name' like '*HTTP*')) | stats distinctcount('Session ID') as SessionCount, count as Requests by 'Client IP', 'User Agent', 'Service Name' | where SessionCount > 5 | sort -SessionCount
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: APM: SQL Injection Attack in Request
rules.description: Detects SQL injection attack payloads in HTTP URLs and query parameters captured by the SOC Application Logs parser from OpenTelemetry-shaped browser/application telemetry. Covers UNION-based, boolean-based, time-based blind, and error-based injection techniques.
rules.oci_query: 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs' and ((('Request URL' like '*UNION SELECT*' or 'Request URL' like '*UNION%20SELECT*' or 'Request URL' like '*UNION+SELECT*' or 'Request URL' like '*union select*' or 'Request URL' like '*union%20select*')) or (('Request URL' like '*\' OR 1=1*' or 'Request URL' like '*\' OR \'1\'=\'1*' or 'Request URL' like '*%27%20OR%201%3D1*' or 'Request URL' like '*\' AND 1=1*' or 'Request URL' like '*OR+1=1*')) or (('Request URL' like '*DROP TABLE*' or 'Request URL' like '*DROP%20TABLE*' or 'Request URL' like '*DELETE FROM*' or 'Request URL' like '*INSERT INTO*' or 'Request URL' like '*UPDATE SET*')) or (('Request URL' like '*WAITFOR DELAY*' or 'Request URL' like '*BENCHMARK(*' or 'Request URL' like '*SLEEP(*' or 'Request URL' like '*pg_sleep*')) or (('Request URL' like '*INFORMATION_SCHEMA*' or 'Request URL' like '*information_schema*' or 'Request URL' like '*sysobjects*' or 'Request URL' like '*syscolumns*' or 'Request URL' like '*ORDER BY 1*'))) | stats count as Attacks by 'Request URL', 'HTTP Method', 'Client IP', 'Service Name' | sort -Attacks
false_positives: Legitimate search queries containing SQL keywords
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: APM: Suspicious JavaScript Execution Patterns
rules.description: Detects suspicious JavaScript execution patterns in browser telemetry indicating crypto mining, keylogging, formjacking, or other malicious client-side scripts. Uses OpenTelemetry browser instrumentation to monitor JS execution context.
rules.oci_query: 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs' and ((('Request URL' like '*coinhive*' or 'Request URL' like '*cryptonight*' or 'Request URL' like '*coin-hive*' or 'Request URL' like '*minero.cc*' or 'Request URL' like '*jsecoin*' or 'Request URL' like '*cryptoloot*')) or ( (('Span Attributes' like '*keydown*' or 'Span Attributes' like '*keypress*' or 'Span Attributes' like '*keyup*' or 'Span Attributes' like '*addEventListener*')) and (('Span Attributes' like '*creditcard*' or 'Span Attributes' like '*credit-card*' or 'Span Attributes' like '*payment*' or 'Span Attributes' like '*checkout*')) ) or (('Request URL' like '*btoa(*' or 'Request URL' like '*atob(*' or 'Request URL' like '*XMLHttpRequest*' or 'Request URL' like '*sendBeacon*'))) | stats count as Detections by 'Request URL', 'Client IP', 'User Agent', 'Service Name' | sort -Detections
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: APM: Total Browser Attacks (24h)
rules.description: KPI tile counting every SOC Application Logs record carrying an Attack Type tag in the last 24 hours. Headline metric for executive dashboards.
rules.oci_query: 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs' and 'Attack Type' != null | timestats span = 1hour count as Attacks
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: APM: Browser Attack Trace Correlation
rules.description: Link analysis grouping events by Trace ID across all SOC sources. Each link group shows the full lifecycle of one logical request: browser telemetry, backend service spans, and any WAF signal that matched the same Trace ID. Use this widget to pivot from a flagged browser attack to the upstream WAF rule that observed the same exchange.
rules.oci_query: 'Log Source' in ('SOC Application Logs', 'SOC WAF Security Logs', 'SOC Web Application Logs') and 'Trace ID' != null | link span = 5minute 'Trace ID', 'Log Source', 'Service Name' | eventstats distinctcount('Trace ID') as Traces, sum(Count) as Events, distinctcount('Log Source') as Sources, distinctcount('Service Name') as Services
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: APM: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Attack in Request
rules.description: Detects XSS attack payloads in HTTP URLs, query parameters, and request bodies captured by the SOC Application Logs parser from OpenTelemetry-shaped browser/application telemetry. Covers reflected, stored, and DOM-based XSS vectors including script injection, event handlers, and javascript: URIs.
rules.oci_query: 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs' and ((('Request URL' like '*%3Cscript*' or 'Request URL' like '*%3C/script*' or 'Request URL' like '*%3Csvg*' or 'Request URL' like '*%3Cimg*' or 'Request URL' like '*%3Ciframe*')) or (('Request URL' like '*onerror=*' or 'Request URL' like '*onload=*' or 'Request URL' like '*onmouseover=*' or 'Request URL' like '*onfocus=*' or 'Request URL' like '*onclick=*')) or (('Request URL' like '*javascript:*' or 'Request URL' like '*javascript%3A*' or 'Request URL' like '*vbscript:*' or 'Request URL' like '*data:text/html*')) or (('Request URL' like '*document.cookie*' or 'Request URL' like '*document.write*' or 'Request URL' like '*document.location*' or 'Request URL' like '*.innerHTML*' or 'Request URL' like '*eval(*' or 'Request URL' like '*String.fromCharCode*'))) | stats count as Attacks by 'Request URL', 'HTTP Method', 'Client IP', 'Service Name' | sort -Attacks
false_positives: Security scanning tools during authorized testing
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Application Authentication Brute Force
rules.description: Detects brute force login attempts against CRM Portal and Drone Shop by monitoring failed authentication events. Correlates with WAF signals and rate limiting events.
rules.oci_query: 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs' and ('Attack Type' in ('broken_auth', 'rate_limit_bypass', 'brute_force') or msg like '*login failed*' or msg like '*auth failure*') | stats count as Attempts, distinctcount(User) as UniqueUsers by 'Client IP', 'Service Name' | where Attempts > 5 | sort -Attempts
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Cross-Service Trace Correlation (CRM ↔ Drone Shop)
rules.description: Correlates distributed traces across CRM Portal and Drone Shop via shared trace_id. Identifies cross-service request flows, order sync operations, and integration health issues. This is the core 360 monitoring query.
rules.oci_query: 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs' | where 'Trace ID' != null | stats count as LogEntries, distinctcount('Service Name') as Services, unique('Service Name') as ServiceList, earliest(Time) as FirstEvent, latest(Time) as LastEvent by 'Trace ID' | where Services > 1 | sort -LogEntries | head 50
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Database Performance Correlation (ATP → APM → Logs)
rules.description: Correlates application logs with Oracle ATP database context. Uses trace_id (set as CLIENT_IDENTIFIER in V$SESSION) to link Log Analytics entries with OPSI SQL performance and DB Management AWR reports.
rules.oci_query: 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs' and ('DB Target' = 'oracle_atp' or 'DB Target' = 'oracle-atp') | stats count as Events, distinctcount('Trace ID') as UniqueTraces by 'Service Name', 'Severity Level' | sort -Events
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Application Error Rate by Service
rules.description: Monitors ERROR-level application logs across CRM Portal and Drone Shop, grouped by service and endpoint. High error rates indicate application health issues requiring investigation.
rules.oci_query: 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs' and 'Severity Level' = 'ERROR' | stats count as Errors by 'Service Name', 'URI Path', 'Error Type' | sort -Errors
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Order Sync Pipeline Health (Drone Shop → CRM)
rules.description: Monitors the cross-service order synchronization pipeline between Drone Shop and CRM Portal. Tracks sync success/failure rates, created/updated orders, and detects sync anomalies.
rules.oci_query: 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs' and msg = 'External orders sync completed' | stats count as SyncCycles, distinctcount('Trace ID') as UniqueRuns, unique('Orders Sync Created') as CreatedCounts, unique('Orders Sync Updated') as UpdatedCounts, unique('Orders Sync Failed') as FailedCounts by 'Orders Sync Source' | sort -SyncCycles
false_positives: Expected failures during Drone Shop maintenance windows
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: OWASP Attack Detection (CRM + Drone Shop)
rules.description: Detects security attacks across both applications with MITRE ATT&CK and OWASP Top 10 classification. Correlates attack type, severity, source IP, and trace_id for full incident reconstruction.
rules.oci_query: 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs' and 'Attack Type' != null | stats count as Attacks, distinctcount('Attack Type') as UniqueTypes, earliest(Time) as FirstSeen, latest(Time) as LastSeen by 'Client IP', 'Service Name' | sort -Attacks
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Request Rate by Service and Endpoint
rules.description: HTTP request throughput across CRM and Drone Shop grouped by route and status code. Identifies hotspots, traffic patterns, and potential DDoS indicators.
rules.oci_query: 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs' and msg = 'Request completed' | stats count as Requests, distinctcount('Trace ID') as UniqueTraces by 'Service Name', 'URI Path', 'Response Code' | sort -Requests
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Security Attack Source IP Analysis
rules.description: Top attacking IPs across both applications with attack type distribution and severity breakdown. Enables IP-based threat intelligence correlation and firewall rule recommendations.
rules.oci_query: 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs' and 'Attack Type' != null | stats count as Attacks, distinctcount('Attack Type') as UniqueAttackTypes, unique('Attack Type') as AttackTypes, distinctcount('Service Name') as TargetedServices by 'Client IP' | sort -Attacks | head 25
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Application Service Health Timeline
rules.description: Tracks application lifecycle and error activity across CRM and Drone Shop in 15-minute service-level buckets. Use for availability monitoring and deployment impact analysis without depending on unsupported raw-message aggregations.
rules.oci_query: 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs' and (msg like '*started*' or msg like '*shutting down*' or 'Severity Level' = 'ERROR') | timestats span = 15minute count as Events by 'Service Name'
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Slow Request Detection (>2s)
rules.description: Detects requests exceeding 2-second latency across CRM and Drone Shop. Correlates with trace_id for APM drilldown and db.target for database performance investigation.
rules.oci_query: 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs' and 'Slow Request' = 'true' | stats count as SlowRequests, distinctcount('Trace ID') as UniqueTraces by 'Service Name', 'URI Path' | sort -SlowRequests
false_positives: Expected slow queries during batch operations
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: SQL Injection and XSS Attack Detection
rules.description: Detects SQL injection and cross-site scripting attacks against CRM and Drone Shop applications. Captures attack payload, source IP, target endpoint, and APM trace for full forensic analysis.
rules.oci_query: 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs' and 'Attack Type' in ('sqli', 'xss_reflected', 'xss_stored', 'xss_dom') | stats count as Attacks by 'Attack Type', 'Risk Level', 'Service Name', 'Client IP' | sort -Attacks
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: WAF Signal Correlation with Application Traces
rules.description: Correlates OCI WAF signals (x-oci-waf-score, x-oci-waf-action) captured by application middleware with the full request trace. Links WAF detection to application-level security spans and database queries.
rules.oci_query: 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs' and 'Attack Type' = 'security_misconfig' | stats count as WafEvents, unique('WAF Score') as WafScores by 'Client IP', 'Service Name', 'URI Path' | sort -WafEvents
false_positives: WAF in detection-only mode generating informational signals
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: ATLAS: Adversarial / Obfuscated Input to ML Endpoint (AML.T0043)
rules.description: Detects crafted adversarial or obfuscated payloads sent to LLM/ML application endpoints using only SOC Application Logs fields. Flags evasion markers in Span Attributes or Query String such as escaped zero-width/bidi unicode sequences, base64 smuggling, JavaScript char-code construction, chat-template control tokens, and token-smuggling separators used to bypass guardrails. MITRE ATLAS AML.T0043 (Craft Adversarial Data) used for evasion.
rules.oci_query: 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs' and ('Request URL' like '*/v1/chat*' or 'Request URL' like '*/llm/*' or 'Request URL' like '*/ai/*' or 'Request URL' like '*/generate*' or 'Request URL' like '*/predict*' or 'Request URL' like '*/invoke*') and ('Span Attributes' like '*\\u200b*' or 'Span Attributes' like '*\\u202e*' or 'Span Attributes' like '*base64:*' or 'Span Attributes' like '*fromCharCode*' or 'Span Attributes' like '*[[SEP]]*' or 'Span Attributes' like '*<|im_start|>*' or 'Query String' like '*%E2%80%8B*' or 'Query String' like '*base64,*') | stats count as Hits, distinctcount('Request URL') as Routes by 'Client IP', 'Service Name' | sort -Hits
false_positives: Legitimate multilingual or binary-adjacent prompts (code, base64 attachments)
Adversarial-robustness test suites run by the ML team
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: ATLAS: LLM Jailbreak Attempt Against Application (AML.T0054)
rules.description: Detects jailbreak attempts against LLM-backed application endpoints using only SOC Application Logs fields. Matches well-known jailbreak personas and bypass phrases ("DAN", "do anything now", "developer mode", "jailbreak", "unfiltered", "roleplay as") in Span Attributes, Query String, or Request URL on chat/completion routes. MITRE ATLAS AML.T0054 (LLM Jailbreak).
rules.oci_query: 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs' and ('Request URL' like '*/v1/chat*' or 'Request URL' like '*/llm/*' or 'Request URL' like '*/ai/*' or 'Request URL' like '*/generate*' or 'Request URL' like '*/invoke*') and ('Span Attributes' like '*do anything now*' or 'Span Attributes' like '*developer mode*' or 'Span Attributes' like '*jailbreak*' or 'Span Attributes' like '*ignore your guidelines*' or 'Span Attributes' like '*without any restrictions*' or 'Span Attributes' like '*roleplay as*' or 'Span Attributes' like '*pretend you are*' or 'Query String' like '*jailbreak*' or 'Request URL' like '*dan_mode*') | stats count as Hits, distinctcount('Trace ID') as Sessions by 'Client IP', 'Service Name' | sort -Hits
false_positives: Safety/guardrail regression suites that intentionally submit jailbreak corpora
Security research traffic from an approved internal team
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: ATLAS: LLM Sensitive-Information Disclosure Attempt (AML.T0057)
rules.description: Detects attempts to coerce an LLM-backed application into disclosing sensitive context, system prompts, secrets, or training data using only SOC Application Logs fields. Matches extraction phrases ("reveal your system prompt", "repeat the words above", "print your instructions", "what is your api key", "training data") in Span Attributes or Query String on chat/completion routes. MITRE ATLAS AML.T0057 (LLM Data Leakage / sensitive information disclosure).
rules.oci_query: 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs' and ('Request URL' like '*/v1/chat*' or 'Request URL' like '*/llm/*' or 'Request URL' like '*/ai/*' or 'Request URL' like '*/generate*' or 'Request URL' like '*/invoke*') and ('Span Attributes' like '*reveal your system prompt*' or 'Span Attributes' like '*repeat the words above*' or 'Span Attributes' like '*print your instructions*' or 'Span Attributes' like '*show me your prompt*' or 'Span Attributes' like '*what is your api key*' or 'Span Attributes' like '*reveal the secret*' or 'Span Attributes' like '*your training data*' or 'Span Attributes' like '*list your tools*' or 'Query String' like '*system_prompt*') | stats count as Hits, distinctcount('Request URL') as Routes by 'Client IP', 'Service Name' | sort -Hits
false_positives: Support workflows where users legitimately ask the assistant to repeat earlier content
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: ATLAS: Bulk Extraction via ML Inference API (AML.T0024 / AML.T0040)
rules.description: Surfaces clients issuing high volumes of inference requests against LLM/ML application endpoints, the telemetry signature of model-extraction and data-exfiltration via the inference API. Ranks Client IP + Service Name by request count and distinct routes touched using only SOC Application Logs fields. Triage threshold: investigate clients with anomalously high Calls relative to the per-service baseline. MITRE ATLAS AML.T0024 (Exfiltration via ML Inference API) and AML.T0040 (ML Inference API Access).
rules.oci_query: 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs' and ('Request URL' like '*/v1/chat*' or 'Request URL' like '*/v1/completions*' or 'Request URL' like '*/v1/embeddings*' or 'Request URL' like '*/llm/*' or 'Request URL' like '*/ai/*' or 'Request URL' like '*/generate*' or 'Request URL' like '*/predict*' or 'Request URL' like '*/invoke*') | stats count as Calls, distinctcount('Request URL') as DistinctRoutes, distinctcount('Trace ID') as Sessions by 'Client IP', 'Service Name' | sort -Calls
false_positives: Batch inference jobs or load tests from an approved automation account
High-traffic legitimate integrations (chatbots, RAG pipelines) with a known baseline
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: ATLAS: Unauthorized ML Inference API Access (AML.T0040)
rules.description: Detects unauthorized or rejected access to LLM/ML inference application endpoints using only SOC Application Logs fields. Filters inference routes returning auth/authorization failures (401, 403) or rate-limit rejections (429) and ranks the offending Client IP + Service Name. Repeated rejected inference calls indicate credential probing or unauthorized model use. MITRE ATLAS AML.T0040 (ML Inference API Access).
rules.oci_query: 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs' and ('Request URL' like '*/v1/chat*' or 'Request URL' like '*/v1/completions*' or 'Request URL' like '*/v1/embeddings*' or 'Request URL' like '*/llm/*' or 'Request URL' like '*/ai/*' or 'Request URL' like '*/generate*' or 'Request URL' like '*/predict*' or 'Request URL' like '*/invoke*') and ('Response Code' = '401' or 'Response Code' = '403' or 'Response Code' = '429') | stats count as RejectedCalls, distinctcount('Request URL') as Routes by 'Client IP', 'Service Name', 'Response Code' | sort -RejectedCalls
false_positives: Misconfigured client retrying with an expired token
Rate-limit tuning windows where legitimate clients briefly receive 429
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: ATLAS: Denial of ML Service / Inference Flood (AML.T0029 / AML.T0046)
rules.description: Surfaces request floods and chaff/spam aimed at LLM/ML inference endpoints, the telemetry signature of Denial of ML Service and resource exhaustion. Aggregates inference traffic by Client IP and route, ranking high-volume sources and the share of error/throttle responses they generate, using only SOC Application Logs fields. Triage threshold: investigate Client IPs with Calls far above the per-service baseline or a high Throttled/Errored share. MITRE ATLAS AML.T0029 (Denial of ML Service) and AML.T0046 (Spamming ML System with Chaff Data).
rules.oci_query: 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs' and ('Request URL' like '*/v1/chat*' or 'Request URL' like '*/v1/completions*' or 'Request URL' like '*/v1/embeddings*' or 'Request URL' like '*/llm/*' or 'Request URL' like '*/ai/*' or 'Request URL' like '*/generate*' or 'Request URL' like '*/predict*' or 'Request URL' like '*/invoke*') | stats count as Calls, distinctcount('Trace ID') as Sessions by 'Client IP', 'Service Name' | sort -Calls
false_positives: Legitimate burst traffic from a known high-volume integration or load test
Autoscaling health probes hitting inference routes
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: ATLAS: LLM Prompt Injection in Application Request (AML.T0051)
rules.description: Detects prompt-injection attempts reaching LLM/GenAI-backed application endpoints using only SOC Application Logs fields. Inspects Request URL, Query String, and Span Attributes for classic instruction-override phrases ("ignore previous instructions", "disregard the above", "reveal the system prompt") that target chat/completion/generate routes. MITRE ATLAS AML.T0051 (LLM Prompt Injection).
rules.oci_query: 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs' and ('Request URL' like '*/v1/chat*' or 'Request URL' like '*/v1/completions*' or 'Request URL' like '*/llm/*' or 'Request URL' like '*/ai/*' or 'Request URL' like '*/generate*' or 'Request URL' like '*/invoke*') and ('Span Attributes' like '*ignore previous instructions*' or 'Span Attributes' like '*ignore all previous*' or 'Span Attributes' like '*disregard the above*' or 'Span Attributes' like '*disregard all prior*' or 'Span Attributes' like '*system prompt*' or 'Span Attributes' like '*you are now*' or 'Query String' like '*ignore*previous*' or 'Request URL' like '*ignore*instructions*') | stats count as Hits, distinctcount('Request URL') as Routes by 'Client IP', 'Service Name' | sort -Hits
false_positives: Red-team or prompt-security regression testing against the GenAI app
Documentation or QA traffic that legitimately discusses prompt-engineering terms
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: OKE: Boopkit Attack Timeline
rules.description: Chronological OKE attack-lab timeline for Boopkit-style eBPF rootkit activity. Shows API reconnaissance, secret access, privileged DaemonSet creation, pod exec, eBPF load, C2 traffic hiding, CronJob persistence, and RBAC backdoor evidence with APM trace pivots.
rules.oci_query: 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs' and 'Service Namespace' = 'octo' and 'Attack ID' = 'attack-oke-boopkit-001' | sort Time | fields Time, 'Attack ID', 'Run ID', 'Attack Stage', 'Security Severity', 'MITRE Technique ID', 'MITRE Technique', 'Service Name', 'Workflow Step', 'Host Name', 'Source IP', 'Process Command Line', 'Trace ID', 'Span ID', msg
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: OKE: eBPF Rootkit Activity
rules.description: Detects Boopkit-style eBPF rootkit activity through bpftool, kprobe, hidden-port, reverse-shell, and /sys/fs/bpf evidence in SOC Application/APM telemetry.
rules.oci_query: 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs' and 'Service Namespace' = 'octo' and ('Span Attributes' like '*boopkit*' or 'Span Attributes' like '*ebpf*' or 'Span Attributes' like '*bpftool*' or 'Process Command Line' like '*boopkit*' or 'Process Command Line' like '*bpftool*' or 'Process Command Line' like '*/sys/fs/bpf*') | stats count as Events, distinctcount('Trace ID') as Traces, unique('Process Command Line') as Commands by 'Attack Stage', 'MITRE Technique ID', 'Security Severity', 'Host Name' | sort -Events
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: OKE: Exec and Node Escape
rules.description: Detects Kubernetes pod exec and host namespace access patterns that can lead to OKE worker node compromise.
rules.oci_query: 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs' and 'Service Namespace' = 'octo' and ('Span Attributes' like '*subresource=exec*' or 'Process Command Line' like '*kubectl exec*' or 'Process Command Line' like '*nsenter*' or 'MITRE Technique ID' = 'T1609') | stats count as Events, distinctcount('Trace ID') as Traces, unique('Process Command Line') as Commands by 'Attack Stage', 'Host Name', 'Security Severity', 'Service Name' | sort -Events
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: OKE: Kubernetes Attack Overview
rules.description: Rollup of OKE/Kubernetes attack simulation events by stage, technique, severity, and service for dashboard triage.
rules.oci_query: 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs' and 'Service Namespace' = 'octo' and 'Attack ID' like 'attack-oke-*' | stats count as Events, distinctcount('Trace ID') as Traces, distinctcount('Span ID') as Spans by 'Attack Stage', 'MITRE Technique ID', 'Security Severity', 'Service Name' | sort -Events
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: OKE: Kubernetes Attack Path Link
rules.description: Link visualization for OKE Kubernetes attacks, grouping attack stage, trace, span, and host evidence into a single investigation graph.
rules.oci_query: 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs' and 'Service Namespace' = 'octo' and 'Attack ID' like 'attack-oke-*' and 'Trace ID' != null | link span = 5minute 'Attack ID', 'Attack Stage', 'Trace ID', 'Span ID' | eventstats distinctcount('Attack ID') as Attacks, sum(Count) as Events, distinctcount('Trace ID') as Traces, distinctcount('Span ID') as Spans
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: OKE: Privileged Workload Creation
rules.description: Detects Kubernetes audit/APM evidence for privileged workload creation, hostPID usage, hostPath mounts, and DaemonSet-based node access.
rules.oci_query: 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs' and 'Service Namespace' = 'octo' and ('Span Attributes' like '*privileged=true*' or 'Span Attributes' like '*hostPID=true*' or 'Span Attributes' like '*hostPath=*' or msg like '*Privileged DaemonSet*') | stats count as Events, distinctcount('Trace ID') as Traces, unique('Process Command Line') as Commands by 'Attack Stage', 'Security Severity', 'Host Name', 'Service Name' | sort -Events
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: OKE: Boopkit eBPF Rootkit Detection Rule
rules.description: Scheduled-rule-safe count of Boopkit-style eBPF rootkit indicators in OKE SOC Application/APM telemetry.
rules.oci_query: 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs' and 'Service Namespace' = 'octo' and ('Span Attributes' like '*boopkit*' or 'Span Attributes' like '*ebpf*' or 'Process Command Line' like '*boopkit*' or 'Process Command Line' like '*bpftool*' or 'Process Command Line' like '*/sys/fs/bpf*') | stats count as BoopkitRootkitEvents by 'Attack ID', 'Host Name', 'Trace ID'
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: OKE: Privileged Kubernetes Workload Detection Rule
rules.description: Scheduled-rule-safe count of privileged Kubernetes workload indicators such as hostPID, hostPath, DaemonSet creation, and pod exec leading to node access.
rules.oci_query: 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs' and 'Service Namespace' = 'octo' and ('Span Attributes' like '*privileged=true*' or 'Span Attributes' like '*hostPID=true*' or 'Span Attributes' like '*hostPath=*' or 'Span Attributes' like '*subresource=exec*' or 'Process Command Line' like '*kubectl exec*' or 'Process Command Line' like '*nsenter*') | stats count as PrivilegedWorkloadEvents by 'Attack ID', 'Attack Stage', 'Host Name'
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: OKE: Secrets and RBAC Abuse
rules.description: Detects Kubernetes secret reads and RBAC backdoor creation, including cluster-admin ClusterRoleBinding grants to workload service accounts.
rules.oci_query: 'Log Source' = 'SOC Application Logs' and 'Service Namespace' = 'octo' and ('Span Attributes' like '*k8s.resource=secrets*' or 'Span Attributes' like '*clusterrolebindings*' or 'Span Attributes' like '*cluster-admin*' or msg like '*ClusterRoleBinding granted*') | stats count as Events, distinctcount('Trace ID') as Traces, unique('Source IP') as SourceIPs, unique('Process Command Line') as Commands by 'Attack Stage', 'MITRE Technique ID', 'Security Severity', 'Host Name' | sort -Events
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: AS-REP Roasting via Rubeus
rules.description: Detects AS-REP Roasting attempts using Rubeus or similar tools targeting accounts without Kerberos pre-authentication.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Command Line' like '*asreproast*' or 'Command Line' like '*GetNPUsers*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: BITS Job Persistence
rules.description: Detects BITS jobs created for persistent execution or file download.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (('Process Name' like '*\\bitsadmin.exe' and ('Command Line' like '*/create*' or 'Command Line' like '*/addfile*' or 'Command Line' like '*/setnotifycmdline*')))
false_positives: Legitimate BITS transfers by WSUS or SCCM
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: BloodHound AD Enumeration
rules.description: Detects execution of BloodHound or SharpHound for Active Directory reconnaissance.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Command Line' like '*SharpHound*' or 'Command Line' like '*BloodHound*' or 'Command Line' like '*Invoke-BloodHound*' or 'Command Line' like '*azurehound*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: BLUELIGHT RAT: Browser Spawning Suspicious Child Process
rules.description: Detects Internet Explorer spawning command interpreters or script hosts. After exploiting CVE-2020-1380 or CVE-2021-26411, BLUELIGHT uses iexplore.exe to spawn cmd.exe, powershell.exe, or wscript.exe for second-stage payload execution.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (('Event ID' = '1' and 'Parent Process Name' like '*\\iexplore.exe' and ('Process Name' like '*\\cmd.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\powershell.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\wscript.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\mshta.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\cscript.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\rundll32.exe'))) | stats count by 'Host Name (Server)', 'Parent Process Name', 'Process Name', 'Command Line'
false_positives: Browser helper objects launching legitimate utilities
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: BLUELIGHT RAT: Browser Credential Memory Access
rules.description: Detects non-browser processes accessing browser process memory with full access rights. BLUELIGHT reads browser memory (GrantedAccess 0x1fffff = PROCESS_ALL_ACCESS) to extract stored credentials, session tokens, and cookies from Chrome, Edge, Firefox.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (('Event ID' = '10' and ('Target Process' like '*\\chrome.exe' or 'Target Process' like '*\\msedge.exe' or 'Target Process' like '*\\iexplore.exe' or 'Target Process' like '*\\firefox.exe') and 'Granted Access' = '0x1fffff') and not (('Source Process' like '*\\chrome.exe' or 'Source Process' like '*\\msedge.exe' or 'Source Process' like '*\\iexplore.exe' or 'Source Process' like '*\\firefox.exe' or 'Source Process' like '*\\crashpad_handler.exe'))) | stats count by 'Source Process', 'Target Process', 'Host Name (Server)'
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: BLUELIGHT RAT: Internet Explorer Drive-by Compromise
rules.description: Detects Internet Explorer making network connections to non-Microsoft domains. BLUELIGHT (S0657) uses browser exploits (CVE-2020-1380, CVE-2021-26411) for initial compromise via watering hole attacks. APT37/InkySquid abuses IE vulnerabilities to deliver the BLUELIGHT payload through malicious JavaScript on compromised sites.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Sysmon Network Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (('Event ID' = '3' and 'Process Name' like '*\\iexplore.exe') and not (('Destination Hostname' like '*.microsoft.com' or 'Destination Hostname' like '*.windows.com' or 'Destination Hostname' like '*.bing.com' or 'Destination Hostname' like '*.live.com' or 'Destination Hostname' like '*.msn.com'))) | stats count by 'Destination Hostname', 'Source IP', 'Host Name (Server)'
false_positives: Legitimate Internet Explorer browsing to non-Microsoft sites
Windows Update checks via IE components
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: BLUELIGHT RAT: File Discovery from Browser Process
rules.description: Detects recursive directory enumeration spawned by browser or script host processes. BLUELIGHT performs file and directory discovery to locate sensitive documents, credentials, and system files for later collection and exfiltration.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (('Event ID' = '1' and ('Parent Process Name' like '*\\iexplore.exe' or 'Parent Process Name' like '*\\wscript.exe' or 'Parent Process Name' like '*\\powershell.exe' or 'Parent Process Name' like '*\\mshta.exe')) and (('Command Line' like '*dir /s*' or 'Command Line' like '*dir /b*' or 'Command Line' like '*tree *' or 'Command Line' like '*Get-ChildItem*' or 'Command Line' like '*-Recurse*' or 'Command Line' like '*ls -R*'))) | stats count by 'Host Name (Server)', 'Parent Process Name', 'Process Name', 'Command Line'
false_positives: System administrators using browser-based management tools
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: BLUELIGHT RAT: C2 via Microsoft Graph API
rules.description: Detects non-standard processes connecting to Microsoft Graph API endpoints. BLUELIGHT uses Microsoft Graph API and OneDrive for command-and-control, blending with legitimate Microsoft traffic to evade network detection.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Sysmon Network Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (('Event ID' = '3' and ('Destination Hostname' like '*graph.microsoft.com*' or 'Destination Hostname' like '*login.microsoftonline.com*')) and not (('Process Name' like '*\\OneDrive.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\Teams.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\OUTLOOK.EXE' or 'Process Name' like '*\\msedge.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\chrome.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\firefox.exe'))) | stats count by 'Process Name', 'Destination Hostname', 'Destination Port', 'Host Name (Server)'
false_positives: Custom applications legitimately using Microsoft Graph API
PowerShell scripts using Graph API for administration
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: BLUELIGHT RAT: Executable Download via Graph API
rules.description: Detects executable or DLL files dropped in temporary directories by processes that also connect to Microsoft Graph API. BLUELIGHT downloads additional tools from OneDrive via Graph API and stages them in Temp or AppData for execution.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (('Event ID' = '11' and ('Target Filename' like '*\\Temp\\*' or 'Target Filename' like '*\\AppData\\*') and ('Target Filename' like '*.exe' or 'Target Filename' like '*.dll' or 'Target Filename' like '*.scr' or 'Target Filename' like '*.bat' or 'Target Filename' like '*.ps1'))) | stats count by 'Host Name (Server)', 'Process Name', 'Target Filename'
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: BLUELIGHT RAT: Obfuscated Script Execution
rules.description: Detects obfuscation techniques in command lines indicative of BLUELIGHT payload delivery. The RAT uses XOR encryption (key 0xCF), Base64 encoding, and SVG-embedded JavaScript for defense evasion during initial exploitation.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Security Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Event Security Logs') and (('Event ID' = '4688' and ('Process Name' like '*\\powershell.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\wscript.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\cscript.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\mshta.exe')) and (('Command Line' like '*FromBase64String*' or 'Command Line' like '*ToBase64String*' or 'Command Line' like '*-enc *' or 'Command Line' like '*-encodedcommand*' or 'Command Line' like '*XOR*' or 'Command Line' like '*char(*' or 'Command Line' like '*-bxor*' or 'Command Line' like '*iex(*' or 'Command Line' like '*Invoke-Expression*'))) | stats count by 'Host Name (Server)', 'Command Line'
false_positives: Legitimate encoded PowerShell scripts used by IT automation
Software deployment tools using encoded parameters
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: BLUELIGHT RAT: Data Exfiltration via OneDrive/Graph API
rules.description: Detects large data uploads to Microsoft Graph API from non-OneDrive processes. BLUELIGHT exfiltrates collected screenshots, credentials, and system data by uploading to OneDrive via Graph API, blending with legitimate cloud storage traffic.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Sysmon Network Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (('Event ID' = '3' and 'Destination Hostname' like '*graph.microsoft.com*') and not (('Process Name' like '*\\OneDrive.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\Teams.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\OUTLOOK.EXE'))) | stats count as Connections by 'Process Name', 'Source IP', 'Host Name' | where Connections > 1 | sort -Connections
false_positives: Custom applications using Microsoft Graph API for file uploads
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: BLUELIGHT RAT: Registry Enumeration of Security Products
rules.description: Detects registry access targeting security product and installed software keys. BLUELIGHT enumerates SecurityCenter2, Uninstall keys, and AV service registrations to identify defensive tools before attempting further payload delivery.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Event ID' = '12' or 'Event ID' = '13' or 'Event ID' = '14') and ('Target Object' like '*\\CurrentVersion\\Uninstall*' or 'Target Object' like '*\\CurrentControlSet\\Services*' or 'Target Object' like '*SecurityCenter2*' or 'Target Object' like '*\\Windows Defender*' or 'Target Object' like '*\\AVAST Software*' or 'Target Object' like '*\\ESET*' or 'Target Object' like '*\\KasperskyLab*')) and not (('Process Name' like '*\\MsMpEng.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\svchost.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\TrustedInstaller.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\msiexec.exe'))) | stats count by 'Host Name (Server)', 'Process Name', 'Target Object'
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: BLUELIGHT RAT: Periodic Screen Capture
rules.description: Detects rapid JPEG file creation by non-image processes. BLUELIGHT captures screenshots at regular intervals and saves them as .jpg files before staging for exfiltration via OneDrive. High frequency (>3 per minute) indicates automated capture.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (('Event ID' = '11' and 'Target Filename' like '*.jpg') and not (('Process Name' like '*\\chrome.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\msedge.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\firefox.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\Photos.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\SnippingTool.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\mspaint.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\Photoshop.exe'))) | timestats span=1minute count as Screenshots by 'Process Name' | where Screenshots > 3
false_positives: Camera or scanning software saving rapid captures
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: BLUELIGHT RAT: WMI System Enumeration from Browser Child
rules.description: Detects WMI-based system enumeration spawned by browser processes. After initial exploitation, BLUELIGHT queries Win32_ComputerSystem, Win32_OperatingSystem, and Win32_Processor to profile the target system before establishing full C2.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (('Event ID' = '1' and ('Parent Process Name' like '*\\iexplore.exe' or 'Parent Process Name' like '*\\wscript.exe' or 'Parent Process Name' like '*\\mshta.exe')) and (('Command Line' like '*Win32_ComputerSystem*' or 'Command Line' like '*Win32_OperatingSystem*' or 'Command Line' like '*Win32_Processor*' or 'Command Line' like '*Win32_NetworkAdapterConfiguration*' or 'Command Line' like '*Get-WmiObject*' or 'Command Line' like '*Get-CimInstance*'))) | stats count by 'Host Name (Server)', 'Parent Process Name', 'Process Name', 'Command Line'
false_positives: System management scripts launched via browser-based admin portals
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: BLUELIGHT RAT: YARA Chrome/Edge Cookie Theft (APT_MAL_Win_BlueLight_B)
rules.description: Detects BLUELIGHT browser cookie theft targeting Google authentication. The malware extracts SID, OSID, __Secure-3PSID cookies from Chrome/Edge to hijack Gmail and Google Account sessions. Enables IMAP access on victim Gmail accounts for persistent email exfiltration. Based on Volexity YARA rule APT_MAL_Win_BlueLight_B $chrome strings.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Command Line' like '*cookie_name: OSID*' or 'Command Line' like '*cookie_name: SID,*' or 'Command Line' like '*__Secure-3PSID*' or 'Command Line' like '*cookie_name: __Secure-3PSID*')) or (('Command Line' like '*GM_ACTION_TOKEN*' or 'Command Line' like '*GM_ID_KEY=*' or 'Command Line' like '*mail/u/0/?ik=*' or 'Command Line' like '*Success to enable imap*' or 'Command Line' like '*Success to enable thunder access*')) or (('Command Line' like '*Failed to get chrome cookie*' or 'Command Line' like '*Failed to get Edge cookie*' or 'Command Line' like '*Failed to get New Edge cookie*'))) | stats count by 'Host Name (Server)', Entity, 'Process Name'
false_positives: None expected - these strings are unique to BLUELIGHT malware
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: BLUELIGHT RAT: YARA Google App C2 Communication (APT_MAL_Win_BlueLight_B)
rules.description: Detects BLUELIGHT C2 communication via Google services. The variant uses custom Google App authentication with spoofed Firefox User-Agent and Korean language Accept-Language headers (ko-KR). Accesses Gmail and Google Account settings to enable IMAP for email exfiltration. Based on Volexity YARA rule APT_MAL_Win_BlueLight_B $chrome strings.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Sysmon Network Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Command Line' like '*ko-KR,ko;q=0.8,en-US;q=0.5*' or 'Command Line' like '*rv:80.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/80.0*')) or ( (('Destination Hostname' like '*mail.google.com*' or 'Destination Hostname' like '*myaccount.google.com*')) and not (('Process Name' like '*\\chrome.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\msedge.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\firefox.exe')) ) or (('Command Line' like '*AccountSettingsUi/data/batchexecute*' or 'Command Line' like '*BqLdsd*' or 'Command Line' like '*SNlM0e*'))) | stats count by 'Host Name (Server)', Entity, 'Destination Hostname'
false_positives: Korean-language users browsing Google services with Firefox 80
The batch execute and SNlM0e patterns are highly specific
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: BLUELIGHT RAT: YARA Keylogger Component (APT_MAL_Win_BlueLight_B)
rules.description: Detects BLUELIGHT keylogger component strings. The malware logs keystrokes with modifier prefixes (SHIFT+, CTRL+, CAPSLOCK+, ALT+) and special key markers ([TAB], [RETURN], [ESC], [ARROW *], [DEL], [WIN]). The keylogger output is staged for exfiltration via OneDrive. Based on Volexity YARA rule APT_MAL_Win_BlueLight_B $keylogger_component strings (27 of 29 required).
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Target Filename' like '*.dat' or 'Target Filename' like '*.log' or 'Target Filename' like '*.tmp') and ('Target Filename' like '*cheV01*' or 'Target Filename' like '*INTEG.RAW*' or 'Target Filename' like '*keylog*')) or (('Target Filename' like '*edb.chk*' or 'Target Filename' like '*edb.log*' or 'Target Filename' like '*edbres00001.jrs*' or 'Target Filename' like '*edbres00002.jrs*' or 'Target Filename' like '*edbtmp.log*'))) | stats count by 'Host Name (Server)', Entity, 'Process Name'
false_positives: Windows Exchange/ESE database operations create edb.* files legitimately
The cheV01.dat file is unique to BLUELIGHT
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: BLUELIGHT RAT: YARA PDB Path Indicators (APT_MAL_Win_BlueLight)
rules.description: Detects BLUELIGHT malware PDB path strings in process memory, file content, or Sysmon ImageLoaded events. Based on Volexity YARA rule APT_MAL_Win_BlueLight (id: 3ec2d44c). The PDB paths 'Development\BACKDOOR\ncov\' and 'Release\bluelight.pdb' are unique to BLUELIGHT compilation artifacts.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Command Line' like '*\\Development\\BACKDOOR\\ncov\\*' or 'Command Line' like '*Release\\bluelight.pdb*') and 'Original File Name' like '*bluelight*') or (('Target Filename' like '*bluelight.pdb*' or 'Target Filename' like '*BACKDOOR\\ncov*'))) | stats count by 'Host Name (Server)', Entity, 'Process Name'
false_positives: None expected - PDB paths are unique compilation artifacts
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: BLUELIGHT RAT: YARA System Reconnaissance JSON (APT_MAL_Win_BlueLight)
rules.description: Detects BLUELIGHT system reconnaissance data collection pattern. The malware collects UserName, ComName, OS, OnlineIP, LocalIP, Time, Compiled, Process Level, AntiVirus, and VM detection results in a specific JSON format and exfiltrates via OneDrive. Based on Volexity YARA rule APT_MAL_Win_BlueLight $msg strings.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (('Command Line' like '*ipinfo.io*') or (('Command Line' like '*"UserName":"*' or 'Command Line' like '*"ComName":"*' or 'Command Line' like '*"OnlineIP":"*' or 'Command Line' like '*"LocalIP":"*' or 'Command Line' like '*"AntiVirus":"*' or 'Command Line' like '*"Process Level":"*' or 'Command Line' like '*"VM":"*'))) | stats count by 'Host Name (Server)', Entity, 'Process Name'
false_positives: Legitimate ipinfo.io lookups (common in DevOps tools)
The JSON field pattern combination is highly specific to BLUELIGHT
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Boot Configuration Change for Persistence
rules.description: Detects BCDEdit commands that modify boot configuration for safe mode persistence.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (('Process Name' like '*\\bcdedit.exe' and ('Command Line' like '*safeboot*' or 'Command Line' like '*bootstatuspolicy*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Browser Credential Store Access
rules.description: Detects processes accessing browser credential stores (Chrome Login Data, Firefox logins.json).
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Command Line' like '*Login Data*' or 'Command Line' like '*logins.json*' or 'Command Line' like '*key3.db*' or 'Command Line' like '*key4.db*' or 'Command Line' like '*cookies.sqlite*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Brute Force: Failed Logon Spike per Account
rules.description: Detects 3+ failed logon attempts (4625) for a single account — indicates password spraying, brute force, or credential stuffing.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Security Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Event Security Logs') and (('Event ID' = '4625')) | stats count as Failures, distinctcount('Source Address') as UniqueSources by User, Entity | where Failures > 3 | sort -Failures
false_positives: Users with expired or forgotten passwords
rules.author: Upstream contributors
