rules.name: Caldera - Credential Search in Config and Environment Files (Windows)
rules.description: Detects broad-scope search for credentials stored in configuration files, scripts, and environment files. Caldera T1552 emulation runs findstr with password-related keywords across common file types and user profile directories, extending beyond the specific filename-based search in credential_file_discovery.yaml.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (( ('Process Name' like '*\\findstr.exe' and ('Command Line' like '*password*' or 'Command Line' like '*passwd*' or 'Command Line' like '*secret*' or 'Command Line' like '*apikey*' or 'Command Line' like '*api_key*' or 'Command Line' like '*token*')) and (('Command Line' like '*/s*' or 'Command Line' like '*/r*')) ) or ( (('Command Line' like '*Select-String*' or 'Command Line' like '*sls *' or 'Command Line' like '*Get-Content*')) and (('Command Line' like '*password*' or 'Command Line' like '*passwd*' or 'Command Line' like '*apikey*' or 'Command Line' like '*api_key*' or 'Command Line' like '*secret*')) ) or (('Command Line' like '*.env*' or 'Command Line' like '*config.json*' or 'Command Line' like '*appsettings.json*' or 'Command Line' like '*web.config*' or 'Command Line' like '*database.config*')))
false_positives: Security hardening scripts auditing for credential exposure
Static analysis tools scanning for secrets
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Caldera - Credential Search in Files via grep (Linux)
rules.description: Detects use of grep or find to search for credentials stored in configuration and history files. Caldera T1552.001 emulation runs grep -r with keywords like password, passwd, secret, token, and apikey across common configuration paths. Complements the SSRF/metadata credential rules with file-system-based grep detection.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'SOC Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Secure Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Audit Logs') and (((msg like '*grep -r password*' or msg like '*grep -ri password*' or msg like '*grep -r passwd*' or msg like '*grep -ri passwd*' or msg like '*grep -r secret*' or msg like '*grep -r apikey*' or msg like '*grep -r api_key*' or msg like '*grep -r token*')) or ((msg like '*grep -r /etc/*' or msg like '*grep -r /home/*' or msg like '*grep -r /root/*' or msg like '*grep -r /var/www/*' or msg like '*grep -r /opt/*')) or ((msg like '*cat /root/.bash_history*' or msg like '*cat /home/*' or msg like '*.bash_history*' or msg like '*cat /root/.mysql_history*')) or ((msg like '*cat /root/.netrc*' or msg like '*cat ~/.netrc*' or msg like '*cat /home/*' or msg like '*.netrc*')))
false_positives: Security hardening scripts searching for credential leaks
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Caldera - Data Collection from Local System via findstr and PowerShell (Windows)
rules.description: Detects collection of sensitive documents and data files from local directories. Caldera T1005 emulation searches for and copies high-value files (documents, spreadsheets, databases, source code) from user profiles and common data paths to a staging location. Complements credential_file_discovery with broader document collection.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (( ('Process Name' like '*\\findstr.exe' and ('Command Line' like '*.docx*' or 'Command Line' like '*.xlsx*' or 'Command Line' like '*.pdf*' or 'Command Line' like '*.pst*' or 'Command Line' like '*.kdbx*')) or (('Command Line' like '*Get-ChildItem -Recurse*' or 'Command Line' like '*Get-Item -Path*' or 'Command Line' like '*dir /s /b*')) ) and ( (('Command Line' like '*\\Documents\\*' or 'Command Line' like '*\\Desktop\\*' or 'Command Line' like '*\\Downloads\\*' or 'Command Line' like '*\\AppData\\*')) or (('Command Line' like '*C:\\Temp*' or 'Command Line' like '*C:\\Users\\Public*' or 'Command Line' like '*C:\\ProgramData*')) ))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Caldera - Data Collection from Network Shared Drive (Linux)
rules.description: Detects collection of data from mounted network shares on Linux hosts. Caldera T1039 emulation accesses SMB/CIFS and NFS mounts, lists their contents, and copies files to a staging location. Patterns include smbclient interactive commands, direct reads from /mnt share paths, and cifs-utils access.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'SOC Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Secure Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Audit Logs') and (((msg like '*smbclient //*' or msg like '*smbclient -L*' or msg like '*smbclient -U*')) or ((msg like '*mount -t cifs*' or msg like '*mount -t nfs*' or msg like '*mount -t smbfs*' or msg like '*mount.cifs*')) or ((msg like '*ls /mnt/*' or msg like '*cp /mnt/*' or msg like '*find /mnt/*' or msg like '*find /media/*' or msg like '*rsync /mnt/*')) or ((msg like '*smb: \\\\> get*' or msg like '*smb: \\\\> mget*' or msg like '*smb: \\\\> lcd*')))
false_positives: Authorized backup agents reading from network shares
File servers serving content from mounted volumes
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Caldera - Data Collection from Network Shared Drive (Windows)
rules.description: Detects bulk file collection from UNC/admin share paths on Windows systems. Caldera T1039 emulation copies or moves files from mapped network drives and UNC paths to a local staging directory before exfiltration. Patterns include xcopy, robocopy, and PowerShell Copy-Item with remote share source paths.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (( ('Process Name' like '*\\xcopy.exe' and 'Command Line' like '*\\\\*') or ('Process Name' like '*\\robocopy.exe' and 'Command Line' like '*\\\\*') or (('Command Line' like '*copy \\\\*' or 'Command Line' like '*xcopy \\\\*')) or (('Command Line' like '*Copy-Item \\\\*' or 'Command Line' like '*cp \\\\*' or 'Command Line' like '*Get-ChildItem \\\\*')) ) and (('Command Line' like '*C:\\Temp*' or 'Command Line' like '*C:\\Users\\Public*' or 'Command Line' like '*C:\\ProgramData*' or 'Command Line' like '*%TEMP%*' or 'Command Line' like '*%TMP%*')))
false_positives: Authorized backup procedures reading from network shares
Migration scripts copying data between shares
Software deployment pulling packages from file servers
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Caldera - Document and Data File Collection from Linux Host
rules.description: Detects collection of document and data files from user home directories and common data paths. Caldera T1005 emulation searches for and copies high-value files (office docs, PDFs, databases, source code archives) using find and cp. Complements linux_sensitive_data_access.yaml which focuses on SSH keys and cloud credential files.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'SOC Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Secure Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Audit Logs') and (((msg like '*find / -name *.pdf*' or msg like '*find / -name *.docx*' or msg like '*find / -name *.xlsx*' or msg like '*find /home -name *.doc*' or msg like '*find /home -name *.xls*' or msg like '*find /home -name *.kdbx*' or msg like '*find / -name *.pst*')) or ((msg like '*find / -name *.db*' or msg like '*find / -name *.sqlite*' or msg like '*find / -name *.sql*' or msg like '*find / -name *.bak*')) or ((msg like '*find / -name *.py*' or msg like '*find / -name *.rb*' or msg like '*find / -name *.php*' or msg like '*find / -name *.go*')) or ((msg like '*cp -r /home*' or msg like '*cp -r /root*' or msg like '*cp -r /srv*' or msg like '*cp -r /var/www*')))
false_positives: Backup agents scanning for changed files
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Caldera - Exfiltration of Staged Data over C2 Channel (Linux)
rules.description: Detects Linux-side exfiltration of collected data over the C2 channel using HTTP POST requests. Caldera T1041 emulation transmits staged files from /tmp or /dev/shm back to the C2 server using curl or wget with POST/PUT methods and multipart form uploads, distinct from the alternative-protocol T1048 pattern.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'SOC Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Secure Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Audit Logs') and (( ((msg like '*curl -X POST*' or msg like '*curl --upload-file*' or msg like '*curl -F*' or msg like '*curl -d @*' or msg like '*curl -T *')) or ((msg like '*wget --post-file*' or msg like '*wget --post-data*')) or ((msg like '*requests.post*' or msg like '*urllib.request.urlopen*' or msg like '*http.client.HTTPConnection*')) ) and ((msg like '*/tmp/*' or msg like '*/dev/shm/*' or msg like '*/var/tmp/*')))
false_positives: Application deployment pipelines uploading build artifacts
Monitoring agents posting metrics to collection endpoints
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Caldera - Exfiltration over C2 Channel via PowerShell (Windows)
rules.description: Detects PowerShell-based HTTP POST exfiltration used by Caldera T1041 emulation. After staging data locally, the operation transmits collected files using Invoke-WebRequest or Invoke-RestMethod with -Method POST and -Body/-InFile parameters to send data back over the established C2 channel.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (( (('Command Line' like '*Invoke-WebRequest*' or 'Command Line' like '*Invoke-RestMethod*' or 'Command Line' like '*iwr *' or 'Command Line' like '*irm *')) and (('Command Line' like '*-Method POST*' or 'Command Line' like '*-Method Put*' or 'Command Line' like '*-Method "POST"*')) and (('Command Line' like '*-Body*' or 'Command Line' like '*-InFile*' or 'Command Line' like '*-UploadFile*')) ) or ('Process Name' like '*\\curl.exe' and ('Command Line' like '*-X POST*' or 'Command Line' like '*--upload-file*' or 'Command Line' like '*-d @*' or 'Command Line' like '*-T *')))
false_positives: DevOps pipelines POSTing build results to CI systems
Application monitoring agents posting health data
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Caldera - Exfiltration to Web Service from Windows Endpoint
rules.description: Detects uploads of collected data to public web services from Windows hosts. Caldera T1567 emulation uses PowerShell or curl to push staged files to paste sites, anonymous file-share services, or cloud storage APIs. This complements the OneDrive-specific BLUELIGHT APT rule with a general cross-service detection.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (( (('Command Line' like '*pastebin.com*' or 'Command Line' like '*paste.ee*' or 'Command Line' like '*transfer.sh*' or 'Command Line' like '*file.io*' or 'Command Line' like '*ix.io*' or 'Command Line' like '*0x0.st*')) or (('Command Line' like '*s3.amazonaws.com*' or 'Command Line' like '*storage.googleapis.com*' or 'Command Line' like '*blob.core.windows.net*' or 'Command Line' like '*objectstorage.oraclecloud.com*')) ) and (('Command Line' like '*Invoke-WebRequest*' or 'Command Line' like '*Invoke-RestMethod*' or 'Command Line' like '*curl.exe*' or 'Command Line' like '*wget.exe*')))
false_positives: Authorized DevOps pipelines deploying to cloud storage
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Caldera - Exfiltration to Web Service via curl (Linux)
rules.description: Detects Linux-side data upload to public web services used as exfiltration channels. Caldera T1567 emulation uploads staged files to paste sites, cloud storage APIs (S3, GCS), or anonymous file-sharing services using curl. Covers the endpoint-level activity that OCI network monitoring may miss.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'SOC Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Secure Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Audit Logs') and (( ((msg like '*paste.ee*' or msg like '*pastebin.com*' or msg like '*ghostbin.co*' or msg like '*transfer.sh*' or msg like '*file.io*' or msg like '*ix.io*' or msg like '*0x0.st*')) or ((msg like '*s3.amazonaws.com*' or msg like '*storage.googleapis.com*' or msg like '*blob.core.windows.net*' or msg like '*objectstorage.oraclecloud.com*')) ) or ( ((msg like '*curl -X PUT*' or msg like '*curl -X POST*' or msg like '*curl -T *' or msg like '*curl --upload-file*')) and ((msg like '*paste.ee*' or msg like '*pastebin.com*' or msg like '*ghostbin.co*' or msg like '*transfer.sh*' or msg like '*file.io*' or msg like '*ix.io*' or msg like '*0x0.st*')) ))
false_positives: Developers uploading code snippets to paste sites during troubleshooting
Authorized backup jobs to cloud object storage
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Caldera - Lateral Tool Transfer via scp/rsync (Linux)
rules.description: Detects transfer of attacker tools or payloads to other hosts via scp, rsync, or curl. Caldera T1570 emulation copies implants from the initial foothold to lateral targets over SSH (scp) or HTTP (curl download-and-execute). Detection focuses on transfers from /tmp or /dev/shm to remote hosts.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'SOC Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Secure Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Audit Logs') and (((msg like '*scp /tmp/*' or msg like '*scp /dev/shm/*' or msg like '*scp /var/tmp/*')) or ( ((msg like '*scp -i *' or msg like '*scp -r *' or msg like '*scp -P *')) and ((msg like '*scp /tmp/*' or msg like '*scp /dev/shm/*' or msg like '*scp /var/tmp/*')) ) or ((msg like '*rsync -avz*' or msg like '*rsync -e ssh*' or msg like '*rsync --rsh=ssh*')) or ((msg like '*curl -s | bash*' or msg like '*curl -sL | bash*' or msg like '*wget -q -O- |*' or msg like '*wget -q | bash*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Caldera - Local Data Staging in Writable Directories (Linux)
rules.description: Detects data staging in world-writable directories prior to exfiltration. Caldera T1074 emulation copies or moves sensitive files into /tmp, /dev/shm, or /var/tmp before transmitting them. Detection is based on bulk copy or move operations targeting these staging paths from sensitive source directories.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'SOC Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Secure Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Audit Logs') and (((msg like '*cp -r /etc*' or msg like '*cp -r /home*' or msg like '*cp -r /root*' or msg like '*cp -r /var/www*' or msg like '*cp /etc/passwd /tmp*' or msg like '*cp /etc/shadow /tmp*')) or ((msg like '*mv /etc/*' or msg like '*mv /home/*' or msg like '*mv /root/*')) or ((msg like '*/tmp/staging*' or msg like '*/tmp/loot*' or msg like '*/tmp/data*' or msg like '*/dev/shm/data*' or msg like '*/dev/shm/staging*' or msg like '*/var/tmp/staging*')) or ((msg like '*find / -name*' or msg like '*find /home -name*' or msg like '*find /etc -name*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Caldera - LSASS Memory Dump via ProcDump or Task Manager (Caldera Emulation)
rules.description: Detects LSASS credential dumping specifically as emulated by Caldera T1003.001 operations. Caldera's credential-access adversary profile leverages ProcDump, Task Manager, or comsvcs.dll MiniDump to extract LSASS memory. This rule covers the ProcDump command-line pattern and the Task Manager dump output file name, complementing the existing lsass_memory_dump_via_comsvcs_dll.yaml.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Process Name' like '*\\procdump.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\procdump64.exe') and ('Command Line' like '*lsass*' or 'Command Line' like '*-ma *')) or (('Command Line' like '*lsass.dmp*' or 'Command Line' like '*lsass.exe.dmp*')) or ('Process Name' like '*\\nanodump.exe') or (('Command Line' like '*avdump64.exe*' or 'Command Line' like '*avdump.exe*')))
false_positives: Authorized memory forensics on production systems
Incident response tooling collecting crash dumps
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Caldera - Network Configuration Recon via ipconfig and route (Windows)
rules.description: Detects ipconfig and route commands used by Caldera T1016 discovery emulation on Windows. The operation chains ipconfig /all, route print, and arp -a to enumerate all interfaces, gateway routes, and ARP cache for network mapping. This process_creation level rule complements the discovery/caldera_t1016 rule with specific binary-level matching.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (('Process Name' like '*\\ipconfig.exe') or ('Process Name' like '*\\route.exe' and 'Command Line' like '*print*') or ('Process Name' like '*\\arp.exe' and 'Command Line' like '*-a*') or ('Process Name' like '*\\nbtstat.exe' and ('Command Line' like '*-n*' or 'Command Line' like '*-r*' or 'Command Line' like '*-s*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Caldera - Remote Data Staging via SMB Share Write
rules.description: Detects staging of collected data on remote SMB shares before exfiltration. Caldera T1074.002 emulation copies files to a UNC share path accessible from the attacker system, consolidating data from multiple compromised hosts. Patterns include net use with copy/xcopy writing to remote UNC destinations.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (( (('Command Line' like '*copy * \\\\*' or 'Command Line' like '*copy /Y \\\\*' or 'Command Line' like '*xcopy /s \\\\*')) or ('Process Name' like '*\\robocopy.exe' and 'Command Line' like '* \\\\*') or (('Command Line' like '*Copy-Item -Destination \\\\*' or 'Command Line' like '*Move-Item -Destination \\\\*')) ) and (('Command Line' like '*C:\\Temp*' or 'Command Line' like '*C:\\Users\\Public*' or 'Command Line' like '*C:\\ProgramData*' or 'Command Line' like '*%TEMP%*')))

IT teams consolidating data for migration

rules.name: Caldera - SMB Lateral Movement via Impacket from Linux
rules.description: Detects use of Impacket tools (psexec.py, smbexec.py, wmiexec.py) from Linux hosts for lateral movement to Windows targets. Caldera T1021.002 emulation leverages Impacket to authenticate over SMB and execute commands on Windows systems within the GOAD AD lab network.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'SOC Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Secure Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Audit Logs') and (((msg like '*psexec.py*' or msg like '*smbexec.py*' or msg like '*wmiexec.py*' or msg like '*atexec.py*')) or ((msg like '*impacket*' or msg like '*smbclient.py*' or msg like '*secretsdump.py*')) or ((msg like '*-target-ip*' or msg like '*-dc-ip*' or msg like '*SMBDomain*')))
false_positives: AD administrators using Impacket for administrative tasks
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Caldera - System Information Discovery via Native Linux Commands
rules.description: Detects use of native Linux commands to profile system hardware, OS version, and kernel details. Caldera T1082 emulation runs uname, hostnamectl, lscpu, dmidecode, and /etc/os-release reads to fingerprint the host before exploitation. This rule complements linpeas/linenum detection by covering non-script-based recon.

rules.name: Caldera - System Information Discovery via systeminfo and WMI (Windows)
rules.description: Detects non-APT system reconnaissance commands used by Caldera T1082 emulation. The operation runs systeminfo.exe, wmic commands, and PowerShell Get-ComputerInfo to enumerate OS version, hotfix history, BIOS details, and hardware specs. rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (('Process Name' like '*\\systeminfo.exe') or ('Process Name' like '*\\wmic.exe' and ('Command Line' like '*os get*' or 'Command Line' like '*computersystem get*' or 'Command Line' like '*cpu get*' or 'Command Line' like '*bios get*' or 'Command Line' like '*qfe list*')) or (('Command Line' like '*Get-ComputerInfo*' or 'Command Line' like '*Get-WmiObject Win32_OperatingSystem*' or 'Command Line' like '*Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem*' or 'Command Line' like '*Get-WmiObject Win32_ComputerSystem*' or 'Command Line' like '*Get-WmiObject Win32_BIOS*' or 'Command Line' like '*[System.Environment]::OSVersion*')))
false_positives: Software deployment tools checking OS compatibility
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Caldera - System Network Configuration Discovery (Linux)
rules.description: Detects Linux commands used to enumerate network interface configuration. Caldera T1016 emulation runs ip addr/route/link, ifconfig, route -n, and arp to map network topology and identify active interfaces after initial access.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'SOC Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Secure Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Audit Logs') and (((msg like '*ip addr*' or msg like '*ip route*' or msg like '*ip link*' or msg like '*ip neigh*' or msg like '*ip -4 addr*' or msg like '*ip -6 addr*')) or ((msg like '*ifconfig -a*' or msg like '*ifconfig eth*' or msg like '*ifconfig ens*' or msg like '*ifconfig lo*')) or ((msg like '*route -n*' or msg like '*route -e*' or msg like '*netstat -rn*' or msg like '*netstat -r *')) or ((msg like '*arp -a*' or msg like '*arp -n*' or msg like '*cat /proc/net/arp*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Caldera - System Network Configuration Discovery (Windows)
rules.description: Detects network configuration enumeration on Windows systems as emulated by Caldera T1016 operations. Adversaries run ipconfig, arp, nslookup, and PowerShell network cmdlets to identify interfaces, DNS settings, and proxies.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (('Process Name' like '*\\ipconfig.exe' and ('Command Line' like '*/all*' or 'Command Line' like '*/displaydns*' or 'Command Line' like '*/flushdns*')) or ('Process Name' like '*\\arp.exe' and 'Command Line' like '*-a*') or ('Process Name' like '*\\nslookup.exe') or (('Command Line' like '*Get-NetIPConfiguration*' or 'Command Line' like '*Get-NetIPAddress*' or 'Command Line' like '*Get-DnsClientServerAddress*' or 'Command Line' like '*Get-NetAdapter*')))

rules.name: Caldera - System Network Connections Discovery (Linux)
rules.description: Detects enumeration of active network connections on Linux systems. Caldera T1049 emulation uses netstat, ss, and /proc/net file reads to list established connections, listening ports, and socket state for network mapping.

rules.name: Caldera - System Network Connections Discovery (Windows)
rules.description: Detects enumeration of active network connections on Windows systems. Caldera T1049 emulation runs netstat.exe and PowerShell Get-NetTCPConnection to list established connections, listening ports, and routing tables for network topology mapping after initial access.

rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Caldera - System Owner and Identity Discovery via id/whoami (Linux)
rules.description: Detects identity enumeration commands used by Caldera T1033 emulation on Linux. rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'SOC Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Secure Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Audit Logs') and (((msg like '*id -u*' or msg like '*id -g*' or msg like '*id -G*' or msg like '*id -Z*')) or ((msg like '*whoami*' or msg like '*logname*')) or ((msg like '*echo $USER*' or msg like '*echo $LOGNAME*' or msg like '*echo $UID*' or msg like '*cat /etc/passwd*')))

rules.name: Caldera - System Owner and User Discovery (Windows)
rules.description: Detects commands used to discover the current system owner and logged-in users. Caldera T1033 emulation runs whoami, query user, and PowerShell Get-LocalUser to determine privilege context, active sessions, and user account details immediately after gaining access to a Windows endpoint.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (('Process Name' like '*\\whoami.exe') or ('Process Name' like '*\\query.exe' and ('Command Line' like '*user*' or 'Command Line' like '*session*')) or (('Command Line' like '*Get-LocalUser*' or 'Command Line' like '*Get-LocalGroup*' or 'Command Line' like '*[System.Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent*' or 'Command Line' like '*$env:USERNAME*')) or (('Process Name' like '*\\net.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\net1.exe') and 'Command Line' like '*user*'))
false_positives: Help desk automation querying session state
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Caldera - System Owner Discovery via whoami and query Commands (Windows)
rules.description: Process-creation level detection of whoami.exe, query.exe, and net user for identity and session enumeration. Caldera T1033 emulation immediately runs whoami /all to determine privilege level and group memberships, and query user to list active sessions. This binary-level rule complements the discovery-category rule that uses CommandLine matching.

rules.description: Detects use of Evil-WinRM or Python WinRM clients from Linux hosts for lateral movement to Windows targets. IT teams using WinRM for cross-platform management

rules.name: Caldera - WMIC OS and Hardware Enumeration (Windows)
rules.description: Detects WMIC-based system profiling commands used by Caldera T1082 discovery operations. The Caldera discovery adversary profile queries Win32_OperatingSystem, Win32_ComputerSystem, Win32_Processor, and installed software to build a comprehensive host profile. This process_creation level rule focuses on wmic.exe command-line patterns distinct from the PowerShell Get-WmiObject variant.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (('Process Name' like '*\\wmic.exe' and 'Command Line' like '*os get*') or ('Process Name' like '*\\wmic.exe' and 'Command Line' like '*computersystem get*') or ('Process Name' like '*\\wmic.exe' and 'Command Line' like '*cpu get*') or ('Process Name' like '*\\wmic.exe' and 'Command Line' like '*product get*') or ('Process Name' like '*\\wmic.exe' and 'Command Line' like '*nic get*'))

rules.name: Caldera/OpenAEV - Exfiltration via OCI Object Storage Bulk Upload with New Bucket
rules.description: Detects creation of a new OCI Object Storage bucket immediately followed by object uploads, a pattern consistent with OpenAEV/Caldera T1567 emulation using cloud storage as an exfiltration channel. Distinguishes from the pre-auth request rule by focusing on the bucket creation + upload sequence.
rules.oci_query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI Audit Logs' and ((('Event Type' = 'com.oraclecloud.objectstorage.createbucket' or 'Event Type' = 'com.oraclecloud.objectstorage.putobject')))

rules.name: Caldera/OpenAEV - Transfer Data to Cloud Account via OCI Object Storage
rules.description: Detects bulk data upload to OCI Object Storage as part of exfiltration to a cloud account. OpenAEV/Caldera T1537 emulation copies staged files to an OCI bucket that may be attacker-controlled or pre-authenticated for external access. Triggers on PutObject API calls following unusual IAM session activity.
rules.oci_query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI Audit Logs' and (('Event Type' = 'com.oraclecloud.objectstorage.putobject'))
false_positives: Authorized application backup jobs writing to OCI Object Storage
Data pipeline ETL processes writing output files
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Certifried (CVE-2022-26923): Machine Account dNSHostName Abuse
rules.description: Detects Certifried, where an attacker-controlled computer account has its dNSHostName set to match a DC and then requests a machine certificate to impersonate the DC. Indicators: Certipy 'req'/'account' chained with a dnshostname write. GOAD lists Certifried alongside the ESC paths.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Command Line' like '*dNSHostName*' or 'Command Line' like '*dnshostname*')) and (('Command Line' like '*certipy*' or 'Command Line' like '*-template Machine*' or 'Command Line' like '*account update*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: ClickFix Fake CAPTCHA PowerShell Execution
rules.description: Detects browser-launched PowerShell patterns associated with ClickFix fake CAPTCHA social engineering, including clipboard instructions, hidden execution, and download cradles.
rules.oci_query: (('Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs') and 'Event ID' = '1' and ('Parent Process Name' like '*chrome.exe' or 'Parent Process Name' like '*msedge.exe' or 'Parent Process Name' like '*firefox.exe' or 'Parent Process Name' like '*iexplore.exe') and 'Process Name' like '*powershell.exe' and ('Command Line' like '*ClickFix*' or 'Command Line' like '*fake CAPTCHA*' or 'Command Line' like '*clipboard*' or 'Command Line' like '*Invoke-WebRequest*' or 'Command Line' like '*iwr*' or 'Command Line' like '*WindowStyle Hidden*')) or (('Log Source' = 'Windows Security Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Event Security Logs') and 'Event ID' = '4688' and 'Process Name' like '*powershell.exe' and ('Command Line' like '*ClickFix*' or 'Command Line' like '*fake CAPTCHA*' or 'Command Line' like '*clipboard*' or 'Command Line' like '*Invoke-WebRequest*' or 'Command Line' like '*iwr*')) or ('Log Source' = 'Windows PowerShell Operational Logs' and 'Event ID' in ('4103', '4104') and ('Script Block Text' like '*ClickFix*' or 'Script Block Text' like '*fake CAPTCHA*' or 'Script Block Text' like '*clipboard*' or 'Script Block Text' like '*DownloadString*' or 'Script Block Text' like '*Invoke-WebRequest*' or 'Script Block Text' like '*iwr*' or 'Host Application' like '*WindowStyle Hidden*')) | stats count as Hits, unique('Command Line') as Commands, unique('Parent Process Name') as Parents by 'Host Name (Server)', Entity, User | sort -Hits
false_positives: Security awareness simulations and browser-delivered helpdesk scripts
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Clipboard Data Collection

rules.name: CMD: Suspicious Command Execution (Real Windows Security Events)
rules.description: Detects suspicious cmd.exe commands in Windows Security Event 4688 process creation logs. Covers reconnaissance, persistence, lateral movement, and defense evasion commands commonly used by attackers after initial compromise.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Security Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Event Security Logs') and ('Event ID' = '4688') and ( (('Command Line' like '*whoami /all*' or 'Command Line' like '*net user *' or 'Command Line' like '*net group *' or 'Command Line' like '*net localgroup*' or 'Command Line' like '*net view*' or 'Command Line' like '*nltest /dclist*' or 'Command Line' like '*nltest /domain_trusts*' or 'Command Line' like '*systeminfo*' or 'Command Line' like '*ipconfig /all*' or 'Command Line' like '*arp -a*' or 'Command Line' like '*netstat -ano*' or 'Command Line' like '*tasklist /svc*' or 'Command Line' like '*wmic process list*' or 'Command Line' like '*qwinsta*' or 'Command Line' like '*query user*')) or (('Command Line' like '*schtasks /create*' or 'Command Line' like '*at *' or 'Command Line' like '*reg add *' or 'Command Line' like '*sc create *' or 'Command Line' like '*wmic /node:*')) or (('Command Line' like '*psexec *' or 'Command Line' like '*wmic /node:*' or 'Command Line' like '*winrs -r:*' or 'Command Line' like '*net use \\\\\\\\*' or 'Command Line' like '*copy \\\\\\\\*')) or (('Command Line' like '*vssadmin delete shadows*' or 'Command Line' like '*wevtutil cl *' or 'Command Line' like '*bcdedit /set*' or 'Command Line' like '*reg delete *' or 'Command Line' like '*wbadmin delete*')) ) | stats count as Detections by 'Command Line' | sort -Detections
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: CMSTP UAC Bypass
rules.description: Detects usage of CMSTP.exe to bypass UAC and execute arbitrary commands through .inf files.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (('Process Name' like '*\\cmstp.exe' and 'Command Line' like '*/s*'))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Coercer Multi-Protocol Authentication Coercion
rules.description: Detects the Coercer tool, which automates authentication coercion across multiple RPC interfaces (MS-EFSRPC, MS-RPRN, MS-DFSNM, MS-FSRVP, MS-EVEN) to force a target to authenticate to an attacker host for NTLM relay.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Command Line' like '*Coercer*' or 'Command Line' like '*coercer.py*' or 'Command Line' like '*EfsRpcEncryptFileSrv*' or 'Command Line' like '*MS-FSRVP*' or 'Command Line' like '*IsPathShadowCopied*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: COM Object Hijacking via Registry

rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Command Line' like '*reg*' and 'Command Line' like '*add*' and 'Command Line' like '*InprocServer32*')))
false_positives: COM component registration during software installation
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Compiled HTML File Execution
rules.description: Detects execution of compiled HTML (.chm) files via hh.exe, which can execute embedded scripts.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (('Process Name' like '*\\hh.exe' and 'Command Line' like '*.chm*'))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Computer Account Creation for Delegation Abuse (MachineAccountQuota)
rules.description: Detects creation of a new computer account by an unprivileged user abusing the default MachineAccountQuota (10). Attacker-created machine accounts are the pivot for RBCD takeovers and Certifried (CVE-2022-26923). Tools include impacket addcomputer.py and PowerMad New-MachineAccount.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Command Line' like '*New-MachineAccount*' or 'Command Line' like '*addcomputer.py*' or 'Command Line' like '*addcomputer*' or 'Command Line' like '*PowerMad*' or 'Command Line' like '*-computer-name*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Constrained Delegation S4U2Proxy Abuse via Rubeus
rules.description: Detects abuse of Kerberos constrained delegation (S4U2self + S4U2proxy) via Rubeus 's4u' to impersonate a privileged user to a target service (often CIFS/HOST/LDAP on a DC). GOAD demonstrates this from accounts trusted for delegation.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Command Line' like '*s4u*' and 'Command Line' like '*/impersonateuser*')) or (('Command Line' like '*/msdsspn*' or 'Command Line' like '*/altservice*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Control Panel Item Execution
rules.description: Detects execution of .cpl files which can be used to execute arbitrary DLLs.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (('Process Name' like '*\\control.exe' and 'Command Line' like '*.cpl') and not (('Command Line' like '*\\System32\\*' or 'Command Line' like '*\\SysWOW64\\*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Credential Access via Certutil Certificate Export

rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (('Process Name' like '*\\certutil.exe' and ('Command Line' like '*-exportPFX*' and 'Command Line' like '*-p*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Credential Dumping via Comsvcs with Rundll32

rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (('Process Name' like '*\\rundll32.exe' and ('Command Line' like '*comsvcs.dll*' and 'Command Line' like '*#24*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Credential Dumping via Windows Task Manager
rules.description: Detects creation of LSASS dump files by Task Manager, which can be used to extract credentials.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (('Process Name' like '*\\Taskmgr.exe' and 'Command Line' like '*lsass*'))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Credential File Discovery
rules.description: Detects searches for files commonly containing credentials such as passwords.txt, credentials.xml, or web.config.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Command Line' like '*passwords.txt*' or 'Command Line' like '*credentials.xml*' or 'Command Line' like '*web.config*' or 'Command Line' like '*unattend.xml*' or 'Command Line' like '*.pgpass*' or 'Command Line' like '*id_rsa*' or 'Command Line' like '*.aws\\credentials*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Credential Manager: High-Frequency Credential Read
rules.description: Detects Event 5379 credential read operations at high frequency — indicates lazagne, seatbelt, or mimikatz vault::cred dumping stored credentials.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Security Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Event Security Logs') and (('Event ID' = '5379')) | stats count as Reads by User, Entity | where Reads > 20 | sort -Reads
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Cryptominer Deployment Indicators
rules.description: Detects indicators of cryptocurrency mining software deployment on Windows systems.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Command Line' like '*stratum+tcp*' or 'Command Line' like '*xmrig*' or 'Command Line' like '*minergate*' or 'Command Line' like '*nicehash*' or 'Command Line' like '*hashrate*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Data Compression for Exfiltration via 7zip
rules.description: Detects data compression using 7-Zip or WinRAR with password protection, often used before exfiltration.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Process Name' like '*\\7z.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\7za.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\rar.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\WinRAR.exe') and ('Command Line' like '*-p*' or 'Command Line' like '*-hp*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: DCOM Lateral Movement via MMC20

rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (('Parent Process Name' like '*\\mmc.exe' and ('Process Name' like '*\\cmd.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\powershell.exe')))

rules.name: DCShadow Rogue Domain Controller Registration
rules.description: Detects DCShadow, where mimikatz registers a rogue Domain Controller (lsadump::dcshadow) to push malicious directory replication (e.g. SID History or AdminSDHolder changes) while bypassing normal change logging.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Command Line' like '*lsadump::dcshadow*' or 'Command Line' like '*dcshadow*' or 'Command Line' like '*/push*')) and (('Command Line' like '*/object:*' or 'Command Line' like '*/attribute:*')))
false_positives: None expected; DCShadow has no legitimate use
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: DCSync Attack via Replication Request
rules.description: Detects potential DCSync attacks by looking for mimikatz-style commands requesting directory replication.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Command Line' like '*lsadump*' and 'Command Line' like '*dcsync*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: DCSync: Directory Replication from Non-Domain Controller
rules.description: Detects directory replication requests (Event 4662) with DS-Replication-Get-Changes GUIDs from non-machine accounts — classic DCSync attack via mimikatz lsadump::dcsync.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Security Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Event Security Logs') and (('Event ID' = '4662' and ('Properties' like '*1131f6aa-9c07-11d1-f79f-00c04fc2dcd2*' or 'Properties' like '*1131f6ad-9c07-11d1-f79f-00c04fc2dcd2*' or 'Properties' like '*89e95b76-444d-4c62-991a-0facbeda640c*')) and not ('Subject User Name' like '*$')) | stats count as Requests by User | sort -Requests
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: DCSync Enablement: Replication Rights Granted via Directory Change (5136)
rules.description: Detects the persistence/setup step for DCSync, where DS-Replication-Get-Changes and -Get-Changes-All rights are granted to a non-DC principal by modifying the domain object ACL (Event 5136 carrying the replication control-access-right GUIDs in its properties). Complements the existing 4662 DCSync detection by catching the rights grant itself.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Security Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Event Security Logs') and (('Event ID' = '5136' and ('Properties' like '*1131f6aa-9c07-11d1-f79f-00c04fc2dcd2*' or 'Properties' like '*1131f6ad-9c07-11d1-f79f-00c04fc2dcd2*' or 'Properties' like '*89e95b76-444d-4c62-991a-0facbeda640c*')))
false_positives: Legitimate delegation of replication rights to a new DC or sync service
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Defacement via Desktop Wallpaper Change
rules.description: Detects commands changing the desktop wallpaper, which may indicate ransomware defacement.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Command Line' like '*Wallpaper*' and 'Command Line' like '*reg*' and 'Command Line' like '*add*')))

rules.name: Default File Association Hijack

rules.name: DFSCoerce MS-DFSNM Authentication Coercion

rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (('Process Name' like '*\\netsh.exe' and ('Command Line' like '*firewall*' and 'Command Line' like '*disable*')))

rules.name: Disk Wipe via Format Command
rules.description: Detects format command execution that could indicate destructive disk wiping.

rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: DLL Hijacking via Service Registry Permission
rules.description: Detects modification of service registry entries to point to attacker-controlled DLLs.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Command Line' like '*reg*' and 'Command Line' like '*add*' and 'Command Line' like '*ImagePath*' and 'Command Line' like '*Services*')))

rules.name: DLL Side-Loading from Suspicious Directory
