rules.description: Detects LD_PRELOAD environment variable injection or /etc/ld.so.preload modification, used for library hijacking and process injection.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'SOC Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Secure Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Audit Logs') and (((msg like '*LD_PRELOAD=*' or msg like '*ld.so.preload*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Linux Log File Tampering
rules.description: Detects deletion, truncation, or clearing of system log files. Attackers tamper with logs to cover their tracks and hinder incident response.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'SOC Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Secure Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Audit Logs') and (((msg like '*rm -f /var/log*' or msg like '*rm -rf /var/log*' or msg like '*truncate -s 0 /var/log*' or msg like '*cat /dev/null > /var/log*' or msg like '*shred /var/log*' or msg like '*journalctl --vacuum*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Linux Network Service Scanning
rules.description: Detects network scanning tools (nmap, masscan, zmap) used for host and service discovery. Attackers use these tools during the discovery phase to map network topology and identify vulnerable services.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'SOC Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Secure Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Audit Logs') and (('Process Name' like '*nmap') or ('Process Name' like '*masscan') or ('Process Name' like '*zmap') or ((msg like '*nmap -s*' or msg like '*nmap -p*' or msg like '*masscan -p*' or msg like '*zmap -p*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Linux Password File Direct Modification
rules.description: Detects direct writes to /etc/passwd or /etc/shadow files, bypassing normal user management tools. This could indicate account creation for persistence.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'SOC Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Secure Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Audit Logs') and (((msg like '*> /etc/passwd*' or msg like '*> /etc/shadow*')) or ((msg like '*tee /etc/passwd*' or msg like '*tee -a /etc/passwd*' or msg like '*sed -i.*/etc/passwd*' or msg like '*sed -i.*/etc/shadow*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Linux Post-Exploitation Enumeration Script
rules.description: Detects execution of common Linux post-exploitation enumeration scripts such as LinPEAS, LinEnum, or linux-exploit-suggester used during privilege escalation.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'SOC Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Secure Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Audit Logs') and (((msg like '*linpeas*' or msg like '*LinEnum*' or msg like '*linux-exploit-suggester*' or msg like '*linux-smart-enumeration*' or msg like '*pspy*' or msg like '*unix-privesc-check*')))
false_positives: Authorized security assessments and penetration testing
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Linux Process Execution from /dev/shm
rules.description: Detects execution of processes from /dev/shm (shared memory filesystem). This in-memory filesystem is frequently used by attackers to stage and execute payloads without touching disk.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'SOC Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Secure Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Audit Logs') and ((msg like '*/dev/shm/*'))
false_positives: Some legitimate applications use /dev/shm for inter-process communication
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Linux Process Injection via Ptrace
rules.description: Detects use of ptrace for process injection or debugging, which can be used to inject malicious code into running processes.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'SOC Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Secure Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Audit Logs') and (((msg like '*ptrace(PTRACE_ATTACH*' or msg like '*PTRACE_POKETEXT*' or msg like '*PTRACE_POKEDATA*' or msg like '*strace -p*' or msg like '*gdb --pid*' or msg like '*gdb -p*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Linux Process Memory Access via /proc
rules.description: Detects reading process memory via /proc filesystem entries (maps, mem, environ). Used to extract credentials, secrets, or encryption keys from running processes.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'SOC Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Secure Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Audit Logs') and (((msg like '*/proc/self/maps*' or msg like '*/proc/self/mem*' or msg like '*/proc/self/environ*' or msg like '*/proc/*/maps*' or msg like '*/proc/*/mem*' or msg like '*/proc/*/environ*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Linux Proxy and Tunneling Tool Detected
rules.description: Detects proxy and tunneling tools used to create covert communication channels. Attackers use tools like chisel, ligolo, reGeorg, and frp to proxy C2 traffic through compromised hosts and evade network security controls.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'SOC Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Secure Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Syslog Logs') and 'Process Name' = 'bash' and (((msg like '*chisel client*' or msg like '*chisel server*')) or ((msg like '*ligolo-ng*' or msg like '*ligolo-proxy*')) or ((msg like '*frpc -c*' or msg like '*frps -c*' or msg like '*frp.ini*')) or ((msg like '*reGeorg*' or msg like '*tunnel.aspx*' or msg like '*tunnel.jsp*')) or ((msg like '*proxychains*' or msg like '*tsocks*' or msg like '*revsocks*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Linux Reverse Shell Detected
rules.description: Detects common reverse shell patterns in process execution, indicating potential remote access backdoor activity.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'SOC Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Secure Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Audit Logs') and (((msg like '*/dev/tcp/*' or msg like '*bash -i >&*' or msg like '*nc -e /bin*' or msg like '*ncat -e /bin*' or msg like '*mkfifo /tmp*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Linux Sensitive Data Collection from Local System
rules.description: Detects mass access to sensitive system files. Attackers collect data from local systems including SSH keys, cloud credentials, database configs, and application secrets for further exploitation or exfiltration.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'SOC Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Secure Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Syslog Logs') and 'Process Name' = 'bash' and (((msg like '*cat /root/.ssh/id_rsa*' or msg like '*cat /home/*/.ssh/id_rsa*' or msg like '*cp /root/.ssh/*' or msg like '*find / -name id_rsa*')) or ((msg like '*.oci/config*' or msg like '*.aws/credentials*' or msg like '*.gcloud/*' or msg like '*.kube/config*')) or ((msg like '*.env*' or msg like '*database.yml*' or msg like '*wp-config.php*' or msg like '*application.properties*' or msg like '*settings.py*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Linux Setuid Binary Creation
rules.description: Detects creation of setuid/setgid binaries. Attackers set the SUID bit on binaries to maintain root-level access even when running as unprivileged users. This is a classic privilege escalation persistence technique.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'SOC Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Secure Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Audit Logs') and (((msg like '*chmod +s*' or msg like '*chmod u+s*' or msg like '*chmod g+s*' or msg like '*chmod 4755*' or msg like '*chmod 4775*' or msg like '*chmod 2755*' or msg like '*chmod 6755*')))
false_positives: Package installation setting legitimate SUID bits
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Linux Shell Profile Persistence
rules.description: Detects modification of shell profile files (.bashrc, .bash_profile, .profile) for persistence. Malicious commands added to these files execute on every user login.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'SOC Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Secure Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Audit Logs') and (((msg like '*.bashrc*' or msg like '*.bash_profile*' or msg like '*.profile*' or msg like '*/etc/profile.d/*' or msg like '*/etc/bash.bashrc*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Linux SSH Authorized Keys Modified
rules.description: Detects modifications to SSH authorized_keys files, which may indicate backdoor access being established.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'SOC Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Secure Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Audit Logs') and ((msg like '*authorized_keys*'))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Linux SSH Failed Login
rules.description: Detects failed SSH login attempts.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'SOC Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Secure Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Audit Logs') and (('Process Name' = 'sshd' and msg like '*Failed password*'))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Linux SSH Tunneling Detected
rules.description: Detects SSH tunneling and port forwarding commands used for pivoting, data exfiltration, or bypassing network security controls.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'SOC Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Secure Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Audit Logs') and (((msg like '*ssh -L*' or msg like '*ssh -R*' or msg like '*ssh -D*' or msg like '*ssh -N -f*' or msg like '*autossh*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Linux Sudo Usage
rules.description: Detects execution of sudo commands.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'SOC Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Secure Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Audit Logs') and (('Process Name' = 'sudo' and msg like '*COMMAND=*'))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Linux Sudoers File Modification
rules.description: Detects modifications to the sudoers file or files in sudoers.d directory. Attackers modify sudoers to escalate privileges or maintain persistent elevated access.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'SOC Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Secure Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Audit Logs') and (((msg like '*visudo*' or msg like '*/etc/sudoers*' or msg like '*/etc/sudoers.d/*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Linux Suspicious Cron Job Content
rules.description: Detects cron job entries containing suspicious patterns such as downloading payloads, piping to shell, or encoding commands typically used for persistence.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'SOC Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Secure Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Audit Logs') and (((msg like '*/etc/cron*' or msg like '*/var/spool/cron*')) and ((msg like '*curl|sh*' or msg like '*wget|sh*' or msg like '*curl|bash*' or msg like '*wget|bash*' or msg like '*base64 -d*')))
false_positives: Legitimate automation scripts using curl piped to shell
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Linux Suspicious Download to /tmp
rules.description: Detects file downloads to /tmp directory using common tools. Attackers frequently stage payloads in /tmp as it is world-writable.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'SOC Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Secure Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Audit Logs') and ((('Process Name' = 'wget' or 'Process Name' = 'curl')) and ((msg like '*/tmp/*' or msg like '*-o /tmp*' or msg like '*-O /tmp*')))
false_positives: Package managers downloading to temporary locations
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Linux Suspicious Network Traffic Redirect
rules.description: Detects iptables or nftables modifications that redirect network traffic, which could indicate man-in-the-middle attacks or traffic interception.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'SOC Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Secure Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Audit Logs') and (((msg like '*iptables -t nat -A PREROUTING*' or msg like '*iptables -t nat -A OUTPUT*' or msg like '*iptables -A FORWARD*' or msg like '*nft add rule.*dnat*' or msg like '*nft add rule.*redirect*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Linux System Owner and User Discovery
rules.description: Detects commands used to discover system owner, logged-in users, and user context. Attackers run these commands early in post-compromise to understand their privilege level and identify other active users.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'SOC Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Secure Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Audit Logs') and (((msg like '*w *' or msg like '*who -a*' or msg like '*last -a*' or msg like '*lastlog*' or msg like '*getent passwd*' or msg like '*cat /etc/group*' or msg like '*groups root*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Linux Systemd Service Persistence
rules.description: Detects creation or enabling of systemd services, a common persistence mechanism where attackers install malicious services that survive reboots.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'SOC Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Secure Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Audit Logs') and (((msg like '*systemctl enable*' or msg like '*systemctl daemon-reload*' or msg like '*/etc/systemd/system/*')) and (msg like '*.service*'))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Linux Web Shell File Creation
rules.description: Detects file creation or modification in common web directories that may indicate web shell deployment for persistent remote access.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'SOC Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Secure Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Audit Logs') and (((msg like '*/var/www/html/*' or msg like '*/var/www/cgi-bin/*' or msg like '*/usr/share/nginx/html/*' or msg like '*/opt/lampp/htdocs/*' or msg like '*/srv/http/*')) and ((msg like '*.php*' or msg like '*.jsp*' or msg like '*.aspx*' or msg like '*.sh*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Local Group Membership Discovery
rules.description: Detects commands enumerating local group membership, especially administrators.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Process Name' like '*\\net.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\net1.exe') and ('Command Line' like '*localgroup*' or 'Command Line' like '*administrators*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: LSA Secrets Registry Extraction
rules.description: Detects extraction of LSA Secrets from the registry, which stores service account passwords and other sensitive data.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Command Line' like '*save*' and 'Command Line' like '*security*')) and not ('Process Name' like '*\\regedit.exe'))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: LSASS Clone via ProcDump Evasion
rules.description: Detects LSASS cloning techniques that create a clone of the LSASS process to dump credentials without directly accessing the original.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Command Line' like '*lsass*' and 'Command Line' like '*-accepteula*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: LSASS Memory Dump via Comsvcs DLL
rules.description: Detects LSASS memory dumping using comsvcs.dll MiniDump export, a technique to extract credentials without dropping tools.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Command Line' like '*comsvcs*' and 'Command Line' like '*MiniDump*' and 'Command Line' like '*lsass*')))
false_positives: Legitimate memory dump by administrators for debugging
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Masquerading System Binary in Non-Standard Path
rules.description: Detects execution of common system binaries from non-standard locations, indicating masquerading.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Original File Name' = 'cmd.exe' or 'Original File Name' = 'powershell.exe' or 'Original File Name' = 'svchost.exe' or 'Original File Name' = 'explorer.exe')) and not (('Process Name' like 'C:\\Windows\\*' or 'Process Name' like 'C:\\Program Files*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Mass Assignment Attack Detected
rules.description: Detects mass assignment attacks where extra parameters are injected into API requests to modify protected fields (isAdmin, role, price). OWASP A04:2021 Insecure Design.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'SOC Web Application Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'OCI Load Balancer Access Logs') and ((('Attack Type' = 'mass_assignment' or 'Attack Type' = 'parameter_tampering')) or (('Request Body' like '*isAdmin*' or 'Request Body' like '*is_admin*' or 'Request Body' like '*"role":*' or 'Request Body' like '*"permissions":*' or 'Request Body' like '*"verified":*' or 'Request Body' like '*"balance":*' or 'Request Body' like '*"price":0*' or 'Request Body' like '*"discount":100*')))
false_positives: Admin API endpoints that legitimately set these fields
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.description: Detects Mimikatz command and module strings in Windows Security Event 4688 process creation and 4624/4648 logon events. Covers sekurlsa, lsadump, kerberos, dpapi, crypto modules and common Mimikatz post-exploitation patterns. Works with real Windows Security Events via Original Log Content matching.

false_positives: Security testing tools that emulate Mimikatz output
Honeypot systems designed to attract credential dumpers

false_positives: Security testing tools that emulate Mimikatz output

rules.name: MSBuild Execution from Non-Standard Location
rules.description: Detects MSBuild.exe executing project files from user-writable directories.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (('Process Name' like '*\\MSBuild.exe') and not (('Command Line' like '*Visual Studio*' or 'Command Line' like '*dotnet*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: MSHTA JavaScript Execution
rules.description: Detects MSHTA executing inline JavaScript or VBScript content.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (('Process Name' like '*\\mshta.exe' and ('Command Line' like '*javascript:*' or 'Command Line' like '*vbscript:*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Named Pipe Impersonation via PowerShell
rules.description: Detects named pipe impersonation technique for privilege escalation via PowerShell.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Command Line' like '*Get-System*' and 'Command Line' like '*NamedPipe*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Netsh Helper DLL Persistence
rules.description: Detects registration of netsh helper DLLs which execute every time netsh.exe is invoked.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (('Process Name' like '*\\netsh.exe' and ('Command Line' like '*add*' and 'Command Line' like '*helper*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Network Share Enumeration via Net View
rules.description: Detects network share enumeration using net view command.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Process Name' like '*\\net.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\net1.exe') and 'Command Line' like '*view*'))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: New Local Account Created via Net.exe
rules.description: Detects creation of local accounts using net.exe or net1.exe.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Process Name' like '*\\net.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\net1.exe') and ('Command Line' like '*user*' and 'Command Line' like '*/add*')))
false_positives: Legitimate user account creation by administrators
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: NPPSpy Credential Interception
rules.description: Detects installation of NPPSpy or similar credential-intercepting DLLs in the Network Provider order.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Command Line' like '*NPPSpy*' or 'Command Line' like '*nppspy*' or 'Command Line' like '*Network Provider*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: NTDS.dit Database Copy Attempt
rules.description: Detects attempts to copy the NTDS.dit Active Directory database file using ntdsutil, vssadmin, or esentutl.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (( ('Process Name' like '*\\ntdsutil.exe' and 'Command Line' like '*ifm*') or ('Process Name' like '*\\esentutl.exe' and 'Command Line' like '*ntds*') ))
false_positives: Legitimate AD backup by domain administrators
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: ntlmrelayx NTLM Relay Execution Indicators
rules.description: Detects execution of impacket ntlmrelayx, used to relay coerced NTLM authentication to LDAP/SMB/HTTP targets for RBCD, ADCS ESC8, or remote code execution. GOAD's NTLM relay scenario relays a coerced hash to a target host.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Command Line' like '*ntlmrelayx*' or 'Command Line' like '*ntlmrelayx.py*')) or ( (('Command Line' like '*-smb2support*' or 'Command Line' like '*--delegate-access*' or 'Command Line' like '*-socks*' or 'Command Line' like '*--escalate-user*')) and (('Command Line' like '*ntlmrelayx*' or 'Command Line' like '*ntlmrelayx.py*')) ))
rules.author: Upstream contributors
