rules.name: Suspicious Usage of nmap
rules.description: Detects execution of nmap with scanning or fingerprinting flags.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'SOC Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Secure Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Audit Logs') and (('Process Name' = 'nmap') and ((msg like '*-sS*' or msg like '*-sV*' or msg like '*-O*' or msg like '*--script*' or msg like '*-A*')))
false_positives: Legitimate nmap usage by system administrators
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Suspicious Usage of passwd
rules.description: Detects execution of passwd with automated password change or removal.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'SOC Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Secure Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Audit Logs') and (('Process Name' = 'passwd') and ((msg like '*--stdin*' or msg like '*-d *' or msg like '*chpasswd*')))
false_positives: Legitimate passwd usage by system administrators
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Suspicious Usage of perl
rules.description: Detects execution of perl with inline execution or network operations.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'SOC Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Secure Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Audit Logs') and (('Process Name' = 'perl') and ((msg like '*-e *' or msg like '*socket*' or msg like '*exec*' or msg like '*system(*')))
false_positives: Legitimate perl usage by system administrators
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Suspicious Usage of python
rules.description: Detects execution of python with inline execution or suspicious imports.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'SOC Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Secure Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Audit Logs') and (('Process Name' = 'python') and ((msg like '*-c *' or msg like '*import socket*' or msg like '*import os*' or msg like '*subprocess*' or msg like '*exec(*' or msg like '*eval(*')))
false_positives: Legitimate python usage by system administrators
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Suspicious Usage of rmmod
rules.description: Detects execution of rmmod removing kernel modules (potential rootkit management).
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'SOC Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Secure Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Audit Logs') and (('Process Name' = 'rmmod') and ( (('Command Line' like '*--force*' or 'Command Line' like '*-f*')) or (('Parent Process Name' like '*bash*' or 'Parent Process Name' like '*sh*' or 'Parent Process Name' like '*python*' or 'Parent Process Name' like '*perl*')) ))
false_positives: Legitimate rmmod usage by system administrators
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Suspicious Usage of ruby
rules.description: Detects execution of ruby with inline execution or network operations.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'SOC Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Secure Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Audit Logs') and (('Process Name' = 'ruby') and ((msg like '*-e *' or msg like '*TCPSocket*' or msg like '*system(*' or msg like '*exec(*')))
false_positives: Legitimate ruby usage by system administrators
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Suspicious Usage of shadow
rules.description: Detects execution of shadow with direct access to shadow password file.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'SOC Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Secure Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Audit Logs') and (('Process Name' = 'shadow') and ((msg like '*cat *' or msg like '*less *' or msg like '*cp *' or msg like '*scp *')))
false_positives: Legitimate shadow usage by system administrators
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Suspicious Usage of socat
rules.description: Detects execution of socat with network or execution redirections.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'SOC Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Secure Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Audit Logs') and (('Process Name' = 'socat') and ((msg like '*TCP:*' or msg like '*EXEC:*' or msg like '*SYSTEM:*' or msg like '*PTY*')))
false_positives: Legitimate socat usage by system administrators
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Suspicious Usage of strace
rules.description: Detects execution of strace tracing other processes.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'SOC Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Secure Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Audit Logs') and (('Process Name' = 'strace') and ((msg like '*-p *' or msg like '*-f *' or msg like '*-e trace=*')))
false_positives: Legitimate strace usage by system administrators
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Suspicious Usage of tcpdump
rules.description: Detects execution of tcpdump capturing network traffic.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'SOC Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Secure Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Audit Logs') and (('Process Name' = 'tcpdump') and ((msg like '*-w *' or msg like '*-i *' or msg like '*not port 22*')))
false_positives: Legitimate tcpdump usage by system administrators
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Suspicious Usage of tshark
rules.description: Detects execution of tshark capturing network traffic.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'SOC Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Secure Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Audit Logs') and (('Process Name' = 'tshark') and ((msg like '*-i *' or msg like '*-w *' or msg like '*-f *')))
false_positives: Legitimate tshark usage by system administrators
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Suspicious Usage of wget
rules.description: Detects execution of wget downloading to temp directories or bypassing cert checks.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'SOC Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Secure Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Audit Logs') and (('Process Name' = 'wget') and ((msg like '*-O /tmp*' or msg like '*-O /dev/shm*' or msg like '*pastebin*' or msg like '*--no-check-certificate*' or msg like '*| bash*')))
false_positives: Legitimate wget usage by system administrators
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Suspicious Usage of whoami
rules.description: Detects execution of whoami in command chain suggesting post-exploitation enumeration.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'SOC Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Secure Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Audit Logs') and (('Process Name' = 'whoami') and ((msg like '*&&*' or msg like '*; id*' or msg like '*; cat*')))
false_positives: Legitimate whoami usage by system administrators
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Suspicious Usage of wireshark
rules.description: Detects execution of wireshark potentially capturing network traffic.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'SOC Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Secure Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Audit Logs') and ((('Process Name' = 'tshark' or 'Process Name' = 'dumpcap')) or ('Process Name' = 'wireshark' and ('Command Line' like '*-i*' or 'Command Line' like '*-w*' or 'Command Line' like '*-k*' or 'Command Line' like '*-f*')))
false_positives: Legitimate wireshark usage by system administrators
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: SyncAppvPublishingServer Abuse
rules.description: Detects abuse of SyncAppvPublishingServer.exe for code execution through PowerShell.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (('Process Name' like '*\\SyncAppvPublishingServer.exe'))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Sysmon C2 Beacon - Periodic Outbound HTTPS
rules.description: Detects periodic outbound HTTPS connections to non-standard destinations that may indicate C2 beaconing activity. Suspicious processes making repeated connections to external IPs on port 443 are flagged.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Sysmon Network Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Destination Port' = 443 or 'Destination Port' = 8443 or 'Destination Port' = 4443)) and (('Process Name' like '*\\rundll32.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\regsvr32.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\mshta.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\powershell.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\cmd.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\wscript.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\cscript.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\certutil.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\bitsadmin.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\msiexec.exe')) and (Initiated = 'true') and not (('Destination IP' like '10.*' or 'Destination IP' like '172.16.*' or 'Destination IP' like '192.168.*' or 'Destination IP' like '127.*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Sysmon Cobalt Strike C2 Network Indicators
rules.description: Detects network connections from processes commonly associated with Cobalt Strike beacon activity. Includes default Cobalt Strike process injection targets and malleable C2 patterns.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Sysmon Network Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (( (('Process Name' like '*\\beacon.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\cobaltstrike.exe') and Initiated = 'true') or (('Process Name' like '*\\rundll32.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\dllhost.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\svchost.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\explorer.exe') and Initiated = 'true' and ('Destination Port' = 80 or 'Destination Port' = 443 or 'Destination Port' = 8080 or 'Destination Port' = 8443 or 'Destination Port' = 50050)) ) and not (('Destination IP' like '10.*' or 'Destination IP' like '172.16.*' or 'Destination IP' like '192.168.*' or 'Destination IP' like '127.*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Sysmon Cobalt Strike Named Pipe
rules.description: Detects named pipe creation matching known Cobalt Strike default patterns. Cobalt Strike uses named pipes for inter-process communication and lateral movement via SMB beacon.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Pipe Name' like '\\MSSE-*' or 'Pipe Name' like '\\postex_*' or 'Pipe Name' like '\\postex_ssh_*' or 'Pipe Name' like '\\status_*' or 'Pipe Name' like '\\msagent_*')) or (('Pipe Name' like '*\\interprocess_*' or 'Pipe Name' like '*\\mojo.*' or 'Pipe Name' like '*\\chrome.*' or 'Pipe Name' like '*\\DserNamePipe*' or 'Pipe Name' like '*\\winsock*' or 'Pipe Name' like '*\\UIA_PIPE*')))
false_positives: Some legitimate software may use similar pipe naming patterns
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Sysmon Configuration Tampering
rules.description: Detects attempts to unload or reconfigure Sysmon to blind endpoint monitoring.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Command Line' like '*sysmon*' or 'Command Line' like '*-u*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Sysmon DNS Data Exfiltration
rules.description: Detects DNS queries with high-entropy subdomains that may indicate data exfiltration via DNS tunneling. Encoded data in subdomain labels is a common technique for covert data transfer.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (('Query Name' matches '^[a-zA-Z0-9]{30,}\\.') or (('Query Name' like '*.dnscat.*' or 'Query Name' like '*.dns2tcp.*' or 'Query Name' like '*.iodine.*' or 'Query Name' like '*.dnsexfil.*')) or ('Query Name' matches '^[0-9a-f]{20,}\\.')) | eval domain_length = length('Query Name') | where domain_length > 30 | fields 'Query Name', 'Host Name (Server)', User, domain_length
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Sysmon DNS Query to Known C2 Framework Domains
rules.description: Detects DNS queries to domains associated with known C2 frameworks and dynamic DNS services commonly used by attackers for C2 infrastructure.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Query Name' like '*.duckdns.org' or 'Query Name' like '*.no-ip.com' or 'Query Name' like '*.no-ip.org' or 'Query Name' like '*.no-ip.biz' or 'Query Name' like '*.ddns.net' or 'Query Name' like '*.zapto.org' or 'Query Name' like '*.hopto.org' or 'Query Name' like '*.serveftp.com' or 'Query Name' like '*.sytes.net' or 'Query Name' like '*.ngrok.io' or 'Query Name' like '*.ngrok-free.app' or 'Query Name' like '*.portmap.io' or 'Query Name' like '*.serveo.net')) or (('Query Name' like '*.onion.ws' or 'Query Name' like '*.tor2web.io' or 'Query Name' like '*.cloudfront-distro.net' or 'Query Name' like '*.azurewebsites.net' or 'Query Name' like '*.herokuapp.com')))
false_positives: Legitimate use of dynamic DNS services
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Sysmon DNS Query to Suspicious TLDs
rules.description: Detects DNS queries to top-level domains frequently associated with malicious infrastructure, phishing, and C2 operations.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Query Name' like '*.xyz' or 'Query Name' like '*.top' or 'Query Name' like '*.tk' or 'Query Name' like '*.ml' or 'Query Name' like '*.ga' or 'Query Name' like '*.cf' or 'Query Name' like '*.gq' or 'Query Name' like '*.buzz' or 'Query Name' like '*.club' or 'Query Name' like '*.work' or 'Query Name' like '*.surf' or 'Query Name' like '*.monster' or 'Query Name' like '*.cyou')) and not (('Query Name' like '*google.xyz' or 'Query Name' like '*microsoft.xyz')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Sysmon DNS Tunneling via Network Connection
rules.description: Detects suspicious processes making DNS connections (port 53) that could indicate DNS tunneling for data exfiltration or C2 communication.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Sysmon Network Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (('Destination Port' = 53 and Initiated = 'true') and (('Process Name' like '*\\powershell.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\cmd.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\nslookup.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\iodine.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\dnscat2.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\dns2tcp.exe')) and not (('Process Name' like '*\\svchost.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\dns.exe')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Sysmon Executable File Created or Detected
rules.description: Detects Sysmon Event ID 29 FileExecutableDetected and Event ID 11 executable file creates in writable or startup locations.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ('Event ID' in ('29', '11')) and ('Target Filename' like '*.exe' or 'Target Filename' like '*.dll' or 'Target Filename' like '*.scr' or 'Target Filename' like '*.ps1') and ('Target Filename' like '*\\Temp\\*' or 'Target Filename' like '*\\Users\\Public\\*' or 'Target Filename' like '*\\ProgramData\\*' or 'Target Filename' like '*\\Startup\\*') | stats count as FileEvents, unique('Target Filename') as Files, unique('Process Name') as Writers by User, 'Host Name (Server)', Entity | sort -FileEvents
false_positives: Installers, browser downloads, and software update packages
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Sysmon Kerberoasting Network Indicator
rules.description: Detects Kerberos ticket requests (port 88) from anomalous processes. Kerberoasting attacks request service tickets (TGS) to crack service account passwords offline.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Sysmon Network Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (('Destination Port' = 88 and Initiated = 'true') and (('Process Name' like '*\\rubeus.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\powershell.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\mimikatz.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\GetUserSPNs.py' or 'Process Name' like '*\\python.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\python3.exe')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Sysmon Lateral Movement via SMB
rules.description: Detects SMB connections (port 445) from processes commonly used for lateral movement. Attackers use PsExec, WMI, and other tools to move laterally through SMB/Windows Admin Shares.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Sysmon Network Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (('Destination Port' = 445 and Initiated = 'true') and (('Process Name' like '*\\psexec.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\psexesvc.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\PSEXESVC.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\cmd.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\powershell.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\wmic.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\net.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\net1.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\xcopy.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\robocopy.exe')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Sysmon Lateral Movement via WinRM
rules.description: Detects WinRM/PSRemoting connections (ports 5985/5986) from suspicious processes. Attackers use PowerShell Remoting for lateral movement and remote command execution.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Sysmon Network Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Destination Port' = 5985 or 'Destination Port' = 5986) and Initiated = 'true') and (('Process Name' like '*\\powershell.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\wsmprovhost.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\cmd.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\evil-winrm.exe')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Sysmon LDAP Reconnaissance
rules.description: Detects LDAP enumeration patterns (port 389/636) from suspicious processes. Attackers use LDAP queries to enumerate Active Directory users, groups, computers, and service accounts.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Sysmon Network Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Destination Port' = 389 or 'Destination Port' = 636 or 'Destination Port' = 3268 or 'Destination Port' = 3269) and Initiated = 'true') and (('Process Name' like '*\\powershell.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\ldapsearch.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\adfind.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\bloodhound.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\sharphound.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\python.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\python3.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\cmd.exe')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Sysmon Mimikatz Named Pipe
rules.description: Detects named pipe creation matching known Mimikatz pipe patterns. Mimikatz uses named pipes for credential extraction and token manipulation operations.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Pipe Name' like '*mimikatz*' or 'Pipe Name' like '*mimilib*' or 'Pipe Name' like '*mimidrv*')) or (('Pipe Name' like '*\\HID_CTRL*' or 'Pipe Name' like '*\\Win32Pipes.*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Sysmon Mimikatz Network Activity
rules.description: Detects network connections from mimikatz or known credential theft tools accessing domain controller services (LDAP, Kerberos, SMB).
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Sysmon Network Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Process Name' like '*\\mimikatz.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\sekurlsa.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\procdump.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\lsass_dump.exe') and Initiated = 'true') or ( (('Process Name' like '*\\mimikatz.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\sekurlsa.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\procdump.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\lsass_dump.exe') and Initiated = 'true') and (('Destination Port' = 88 or 'Destination Port' = 389 or 'Destination Port' = 445 or 'Destination Port' = 636 or 'Destination Port' = 3268)) ))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Sysmon PsExec Named Pipe
rules.description: Detects named pipe creation matching PsExec default pipe names. PsExec creates named pipes for remote command execution and is commonly used for lateral movement.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Pipe Name' like '*\\PSEXESVC*' or 'Pipe Name' like '*\\psexec*' or 'Pipe Name' like '*\\csexec*' or 'Pipe Name' like '*\\remcom*' or 'Pipe Name' like '*\\PAExec*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Sysmon RDP Lateral Movement
rules.description: Detects outbound RDP connections (port 3389) from unusual processes. While RDP is commonly used for administration, connections from non-standard processes may indicate lateral movement.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Sysmon Network Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (('Destination Port' = 3389 and Initiated = 'true') and (('Process Name' like '*\\cmd.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\powershell.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\wscript.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\mstsc.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\tscon.exe')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Sysmon Suspicious Named Pipe Pattern
rules.description: Detects named pipe creation matching common C2 framework patterns including Metasploit, Covenant, and other post-exploitation tools.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Pipe Name' like '\\msf-pipe*' or 'Pipe Name' like '\\meterpreter*')) or (('Pipe Name' like '\\gruntsvc*' or 'Pipe Name' like '\\Covenant*')) or (('Pipe Name' like '*\\evil*' or 'Pipe Name' like '*\\implant*' or 'Pipe Name' like '*\\beacon*' or 'Pipe Name' like '*\\c2pipe*' or 'Pipe Name' like '*\\shell_pipe*' or 'Pipe Name' like '*\\payload*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Sysmon Suspicious Outbound Connection from LOLBin
rules.description: Detects outbound network connections from Living-off-the-Land binaries (LOLBins) to external IP addresses. These binaries are commonly abused by attackers for downloading payloads and establishing C2.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Sysmon Network Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Process Name' like '*\\certutil.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\bitsadmin.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\mshta.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\regsvr32.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\rundll32.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\wscript.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\cscript.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\msiexec.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\installutil.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\msdt.exe') and Initiated = 'true') and not (('Destination IP' like '10.*' or 'Destination IP' like '172.16.*' or 'Destination IP' like '192.168.*' or 'Destination IP' like '127.*')))
false_positives: Legitimate use of certutil for certificate operations
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: System Recovery Disabled via BCDEdit
rules.description: Detects BCDEdit commands disabling system recovery, commonly seen in ransomware attacks.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (('Process Name' like '*\\bcdedit.exe' and ('Command Line' like '*recoveryenabled*' or 'Command Line' like '*No*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: System Shutdown or Reboot via shutdown.exe
rules.description: Detects forced system shutdown or reboot commands that may be part of destructive operations.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (('Process Name' like '*\\shutdown.exe' and ('Command Line' like '*/s*' or 'Command Line' like '*/r*' or 'Command Line' like '*/f*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Targeted AS-REP Roasting: DoNotRequirePreAuth Set
rules.description: Detects targeted AS-REP roasting, where an attacker with write access disables Kerberos pre-authentication (DONT_REQ_PREAUTH) on an account so its AS-REP can be requested and cracked offline. Indicators: Set-ADAccountControl -DoesNotRequirePreAuth, or PowerView Set-DomainObject toggling useraccountcontrol.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Command Line' like '*DoesNotRequirePreAuth*' or 'Command Line' like '*DONT_REQ_PREAUTH*' or 'Command Line' like '*DONT_REQUIRE_PREAUTH*')) or (('Command Line' like '*useraccountcontrol*' and 'Command Line' like '*4194304*')))
false_positives: Legacy accounts intentionally configured without pre-authentication
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Targeted Kerberoasting: SPN Set on User Account
rules.description: Detects targeted kerberoasting, where an attacker with write access to a user object sets a servicePrincipalName so the account becomes kerberoastable, then requests and removes it. Indicators: Set-ADUser/Set-DomainObject writing serviceprincipalname, or the targetedKerberoast tool.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Command Line' like '*serviceprincipalname*' or 'Command Line' like '*targetedKerberoast*' or 'Command Line' like '*Set-DomainObject*')) and (('Command Line' like '*Set-ADUser*' or 'Command Line' like '*-ServicePrincipalName*' or 'Command Line' like '*targetedKerberoast*' or 'Command Line' like '*serviceprincipalname*')))
false_positives: Legitimate SPN registration for new services
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Template Injection via Microsoft Office
rules.description: Detects Office applications loading remote templates, a technique to deliver malicious macros.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Parent Process Name' like '*\\WINWORD.EXE' or 'Parent Process Name' like '*\\EXCEL.EXE' or 'Parent Process Name' like '*\\POWERPNT.EXE') and 'Command Line' like '*http*'))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Time Provider DLL Persistence
rules.description: Detects registration of time provider DLLs for high-privilege persistence.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Command Line' like '*TimeProviders*' and 'Command Line' like '*DllName*' and 'Command Line' like '*reg*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Timeroasting: Computer Account Hash Harvest via NTP
rules.description: Detects Timeroasting, which abuses the unauthenticated MS-SNTP extension to request authenticators for computer accounts using only their RID, yielding MD5-based hashes for offline cracking without any domain credentials.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Command Line' like '*timeroast*' or 'Command Line' like '*timeroasting*' or 'Command Line' like '*sntp_roast*' or 'Command Line' like '*MS-SNTP*')))
false_positives: None expected; no legitimate use of timeroasting tooling
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Timestomping via PowerShell
rules.description: Detects PowerShell commands modifying file timestamps to blend malicious files with legitimate ones.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Command Line' like '*CreationTime*' and 'Command Line' like '*LastWriteTime*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Token Impersonation via Incognito
rules.description: Detects usage of Incognito or similar tools for Windows access token manipulation and impersonation.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Command Line' like '*incognito*' or 'Command Line' like '*list_tokens*' or 'Command Line' like '*impersonate_token*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Token Manipulation via RunAs
rules.description: Detects suspicious RunAs usage that may indicate token manipulation for privilege escalation.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (('Process Name' like '*\\runas.exe' and 'Command Line' like '*/netonly*'))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: UAC Bypass via ComputerDefaults
rules.description: Detects UAC bypass using computerdefaults.exe auto-elevation.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (('Parent Process Name' like '*\\computerdefaults.exe' and ('Process Name' like '*\\cmd.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\powershell.exe')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: UAC Bypass via DiskCleanup
rules.description: Detects UAC bypass using environment variable manipulation with DiskCleanup.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (('Parent Process Name' like '*\\svchost.exe' and 'Process Name' like '*\\DismHost.exe'))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: UAC Bypass via Eventvwr
rules.description: Detects UAC bypass using eventvwr.exe registry hijacking.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (('Parent Process Name' like '*\\eventvwr.exe' and ('Process Name' like '*\\cmd.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\powershell.exe')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: UAC Bypass via Fodhelper
rules.description: Detects UAC bypass using fodhelper.exe to execute commands with elevated privileges.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (('Parent Process Name' like '*\\fodhelper.exe') and not ('Process Name' like '*\\fodhelper.exe'))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Unconstrained Delegation TGT Capture via Rubeus monitor
rules.description: Detects harvesting of TGTs cached on a host trusted for unconstrained delegation. Rubeus 'monitor'/'dump' continuously extracts forwarded TGTs (often paired with a coercion such as Printerbug to force a DC to authenticate). GOAD chains unconstrained delegation with the printer bug.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Command Line' like '*monitor /interval*' or 'Command Line' like '*rubeus monitor*' or 'Command Line' like '*triage*')) or (('Command Line' like '*dump*' and 'Command Line' like '*/service:krbtgt*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Unquoted Service Path Exploitation
rules.description: Detects commands querying for unquoted service paths, a privilege escalation vector.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Command Line' like '*wmic*' and 'Command Line' like '*service*' and 'Command Line' like '*pathname*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Unusually Large HTTP Response (Data Exfiltration)
rules.description: Detects unusually large HTTP responses that may indicate successful data exfiltration (database dumps, bulk user data extraction). OWASP A01:2021 Broken Access Control.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'OCI Load Balancer Access Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Load Balancer Access Logs') and (('Response Code' = '200') and (('Request URL' like '*/api/*' or 'Request URL' like '*/export*' or 'Request URL' like '*/download*' or 'Request URL' like '*/dump*' or 'Request URL' like '*/backup*' or 'Request URL' like '*/users*' or 'Request URL' like '*/data*' or 'Request URL' like '*/report*' or 'Request URL' like '*/vulnerable*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: VBA Macro Spawning Suspicious Child Process
rules.description: Detects Office applications spawning command shells or scripting engines, indicating macro execution.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Parent Process Name' like '*\\WINWORD.EXE' or 'Parent Process Name' like '*\\EXCEL.EXE' or 'Parent Process Name' like '*\\POWERPNT.EXE' or 'Parent Process Name' like '*\\OUTLOOK.EXE') and ('Process Name' like '*\\cmd.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\powershell.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\wscript.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\cscript.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\mshta.exe')))
false_positives: Legitimate macros that launch helper scripts
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Virtualization Sandbox Evasion Check
rules.description: Detects commands checking for virtualization or sandbox environments before executing payloads.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Command Line' like '*VBOX*' or 'Command Line' like '*VMware*' or 'Command Line' like '*VirtualBox*' or 'Command Line' like '*qemu*' or 'Command Line' like '*xen*' or 'Command Line' like '*SbieDll.dll*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Visual Basic Script Compilation via vbc.exe
rules.description: Detects compilation of Visual Basic code using vbc.exe from non-standard locations.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (('Process Name' like '*\\vbc.exe') and not ('Parent Process Name' like '*Visual Studio*'))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Volume Shadow Copy Deletion via WMIC
rules.description: Detects deletion of volume shadow copies using WMIC, a common ransomware preparation step.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (('Process Name' like '*\\wmic.exe' and ('Command Line' like '*shadowcopy*' and 'Command Line' like '*delete*')))
false_positives: Shadow copy cleanup by storage management
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: WAF Command Injection Attack Blocked
rules.description: Detects OS command injection attempts blocked by OCI WAF. Attackers inject system commands through web parameters. OWASP A03:2021 Injection.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'OCI WAF Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC WAF Security Logs') and (('Action' = 'BLOCK') and ( (('Request URL' like '*; ls*' or 'Request URL' like '*; cat *' or 'Request URL' like '*; id*' or 'Request URL' like '*; whoami*' or 'Request URL' like '*; ping *' or 'Request URL' like '*; wget *' or 'Request URL' like '*; curl *' or 'Request URL' like '*| ls*' or 'Request URL' like '*| cat *' or 'Request URL' like '*| id*' or 'Request URL' like '*| whoami*' or 'Request URL' like '*`id`*' or 'Request URL' like '*`whoami`*' or 'Request URL' like '*$(id)*' or 'Request URL' like '*$(whoami)*' or 'Request URL' like '*$(/bin/bash*' or 'Request URL' like '*/bin/sh -c*' or 'Request URL' like '*cmd.exe /c*' or 'Request URL' like '*powershell -*')) or ('Rule Key' like '*932*') ))
false_positives: Legitimate API endpoints that accept command-like parameters
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: WAF CORS Bypass Attempt Blocked
rules.description: Detects CORS misconfiguration exploitation attempts where attackers try to bypass cross-origin restrictions. OWASP A05:2021 Security Misconfiguration.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'OCI WAF Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC WAF Security Logs') and (('Action' = 'BLOCK') and (('Request Headers' like '*Origin: null*' or 'Request Headers' like '*Origin: http://evil*' or 'Request Headers' like '*Origin: https://evil*' or 'Request Headers' like '*Origin: http://attacker*' or 'Request Headers' like '*Access-Control-Allow-Origin: **')))
false_positives: Mobile apps with custom origin headers
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: WAF Cross-Site Scripting Attack Blocked
rules.description: Detects XSS (Cross-Site Scripting) attempts blocked by OCI WAF. Part of OWASP A03:2021 Injection category.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'OCI WAF Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC WAF Security Logs') and (('Action' = 'BLOCK') and ( (('Request URL' like '*
false_positives: Developers testing JavaScript in form fields
Rich text editors with script content
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: WAF LDAP Injection Attack Blocked
rules.description: Detects LDAP injection attempts blocked by WAF. Attackers manipulate LDAP queries to bypass authentication or extract directory information. OWASP A03:2021 Injection.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'OCI WAF Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC WAF Security Logs') and (('Action' = 'BLOCK') and (('Request URL' like '*)(cn=*' or 'Request URL' like '*)(uid=*' or 'Request URL' like '*)(mail=*' or 'Request URL' like '*)(|(cn=*' or 'Request URL' like '**)(&*' or 'Request URL' like '**)(objectClass=*' or 'Request URL' like '*)(userPassword=*' or 'Request URL' like '**))(|*' or 'Request URL' like '*admin)(&)*' or 'Request URL' like '*x])(objectClass*')))
false_positives: LDAP-based search functionality with special characters
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: WAF Log4Shell (CVE-2021-44228) Attack Blocked
rules.description: Detects Log4Shell (Log4j RCE) exploitation attempts blocked by WAF. Attackers use JNDI lookup strings to achieve remote code execution. OWASP A06:2021 Vulnerable and Outdated Components.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'OCI WAF Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC WAF Security Logs') and (('Action' = 'BLOCK') and ( (('Request URL' like '*${jndi:*' or 'Request URL' like '*${jndi:ldap:*' or 'Request URL' like '*${jndi:rmi:*' or 'Request URL' like '*${jndi:dns:*' or 'Request URL' like '*${jndi:ldaps:*' or 'Request URL' like '*${j]n[d]i:*' or 'Request URL' like '*${${lower:j}*' or 'Request URL' like '*${${upper:j}*' or 'Request URL' like '*${${::-j}*' or 'Request URL' like '*%24%7Bjndi*' or 'Request URL' like '*$%7Bjndi*')) or (('Request Headers' like '*${jndi:*' or 'Request Headers' like '*${jndi:ldap:*')) or (('User Agent' like '*${jndi:*' or 'User Agent' like '*${jndi:ldap:*')) ))
false_positives: Security tools scanning for Log4j vulnerabilities
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: WAF NoSQL Injection Attack Blocked
rules.description: Detects NoSQL injection attempts (MongoDB, CouchDB) blocked by WAF. Attackers inject NoSQL query operators to bypass authentication or extract data. OWASP A03:2021 Injection.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'OCI WAF Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC WAF Security Logs') and (('Action' = 'BLOCK') and ( (('Request URL' like '*$gt*' or 'Request URL' like '*$ne*' or 'Request URL' like '*$regex*' or 'Request URL' like '*$where*' or 'Request URL' like '*$exists*' or 'Request URL' like '*$nin*' or 'Request URL' like '*$or*' or 'Request URL' like '*$and*' or 'Request URL' like '*[$gt]*' or 'Request URL' like '*[$ne]*' or 'Request URL' like '*[$regex]*' or 'Request URL' like '*{$gt:*' or 'Request URL' like '*{$ne:*')) or (('Request Body' like '*$gt*' or 'Request Body' like '*$ne*' or 'Request Body' like '*$regex*' or 'Request Body' like '*$where*' or 'Request Body' like '*{"$gt":*')) ))
false_positives: Legitimate MongoDB query APIs exposed through REST
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: WAF Path Traversal Attack Blocked
rules.description: Detects directory traversal (path traversal) attacks blocked by WAF. Attackers attempt to access files outside the web root using ../ sequences. OWASP A01:2021 Broken Access Control.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'OCI WAF Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC WAF Security Logs') and (('Action' = 'BLOCK') and ( (('Request URL' like '*../*' or 'Request URL' like '*..%2f*' or 'Request URL' like '*..%5c*' or 'Request URL' like '*..%252f*' or 'Request URL' like '*%2e%2e/*' or 'Request URL' like '*%2e%2e%2f*' or 'Request URL' like '*..../*' or 'Request URL' like '*/etc/passwd*' or 'Request URL' like '*/etc/shadow*' or 'Request URL' like '*/proc/self*' or 'Request URL' like '*/windows/system32*' or 'Request URL' like '*boot.ini*' or 'Request URL' like '*win.ini*')) or ('Rule Key' like '*930*') ))
false_positives: Misconfigured web applications with legitimate relative paths
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: WAF Protocol Attack Blocked
rules.description: Detects HTTP protocol violation attacks blocked by WAF (request smuggling, header injection, HTTP splitting). OWASP A05:2021 Security Misconfiguration.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'OCI WAF Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC WAF Security Logs') and (('Action' = 'BLOCK') and ( (('Rule Key' like '*920*' or 'Rule Key' like '*921*')) or (('Request Headers' like '*%0d%0a*' or 'Request Headers' like '*%0D%0A*' or 'Request Headers' like '*Transfer-Encoding: chunked*' or 'Request Headers' like '*Content-Length: 0*')) ))
false_positives: Legitimate HTTP clients with unusual header formatting
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: WAF Rate Limiting Triggered
rules.description: Detects WAF rate limiting events indicating automated attack tools or brute force attempts. Rate limiting is configured at 100 requests per minute for Seven Kingdoms Portal.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'OCI WAF Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC WAF Security Logs') and (('Rule Type' = 'REQUEST_RATE_LIMITING'))
false_positives: Legitimate high-traffic users or API consumers
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: WAF Server-Side Request Forgery Blocked
rules.description: Detects SSRF attempts blocked by WAF where attackers try to make the server fetch internal resources. OWASP A10:2021 Server-Side Request Forgery.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'OCI WAF Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC WAF Security Logs') and (('Action' = 'BLOCK') and (('Request URL' like '*169.254.169.254*' or 'Request URL' like '*metadata.google*' or 'Request URL' like '*100.100.100.200*' or 'Request URL' like '*localhost*' or 'Request URL' like '*127.0.0.1*' or 'Request URL' like '*0.0.0.0*' or 'Request URL' like '*[::]*' or 'Request URL' like '*0x7f000001*' or 'Request URL' like '*2130706433*' or 'Request URL' like '*http://10.*' or 'Request URL' like '*http://172.16*' or 'Request URL' like '*http://172.17*' or 'Request URL' like '*http://172.18*' or 'Request URL' like '*http://192.168*' or 'Request URL' like '*file:///*' or 'Request URL' like '*gopher://*' or 'Request URL' like '*dict://*' or 'Request URL' like '*oraclecloud.com/opc*' or 'Request URL' like '*metadata.oraclecloud.com*')))
false_positives: Internal health check endpoints configured through URL parameters
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: WAF Server-Side Template Injection Blocked
rules.description: Detects Server-Side Template Injection (SSTI) attempts blocked by WAF. Attackers inject template syntax to achieve remote code execution via template engines (Jinja2, Twig, Freemarker).
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'OCI WAF Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC WAF Security Logs') and (('Action' = 'BLOCK') and (('Request URL' like '*{{7*7}}*' or 'Request URL' like '*{{config}}*' or 'Request URL' like '*${7*7}*' or 'Request URL' like '*#{7*7}*' or 'Request URL' like '*<%= 7*7 %>*' or 'Request URL' like '*{{\'\'.__class__*' or 'Request URL' like '*__mro__*' or 'Request URL' like '*__subclasses__*' or 'Request URL' like '*__builtins__*' or 'Request URL' like '*__import__*' or 'Request URL' like '*lipsum.__globals__*' or 'Request URL' like '*cycler.__init__*' or 'Request URL' like '*joiner.__init__*' or 'Request URL' like '*request.application*' or 'Request URL' like '*${T(java.lang.Runtime)}*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: WAF SQL Injection Attack Allowed Through
rules.description: Detects SQL injection attempts that were ALLOWED through WAF (detection-only mode or rule bypass). Critical alert indicating potential successful exploitation.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'OCI WAF Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC WAF Security Logs') and (('Action' = 'DETECT') and (('Request URL' like '* OR 1=1*' or 'Request URL' like '* or 1=1*' or 'Request URL' like '*1=1*' or 'Request URL' like '*\' OR 1=1*' or 'Request URL' like '*\' or 1=1*' or 'Request URL' like '*\' OR \'1\'=\'1*' or 'Request URL' like '*\' or \'1\'=\'1*' or 'Request URL' like '*\' AND 1=1*' or 'Request URL' like '*%27%20OR%201%3D1*' or 'Request URL' like '*%27+OR+1%3D1*' or 'Request URL' like '*UNION SELECT*' or 'Request URL' like '*union select*' or 'Request URL' like '*UNION%20SELECT*' or 'Request URL' like '*DROP TABLE*' or 'Request URL' like '*drop table*' or 'Request URL' like '*--*' or 'Request URL' like '*INFORMATION_SCHEMA*' or 'Request URL' like '*information_schema*' or 'Request URL' like '*SLEEP(*' or 'Request URL' like '*BENCHMARK(*' or 'Request URL' like '*EXTRACTVALUE(*')))
false_positives: WAF in detection-only mode during initial tuning
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: WAF SQL Injection Attack Blocked
rules.description: Detects SQL injection attempts blocked by OCI WAF. Indicates active exploitation of OWASP A03:2021 Injection vulnerabilities against the web application.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'OCI WAF Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC WAF Security Logs') and (('Action' = 'BLOCK') and (('Request URL' like '*UNION SELECT*' or 'Request URL' like '*union select*' or 'Request URL' like '*UNION%20SELECT*' or 'Request URL' like '*DROP TABLE*' or 'Request URL' like '*drop table*' or 'Request URL' like '*ORDER BY 1*' or 'Request URL' like '*order by 1*' or 'Request URL' like '*INFORMATION_SCHEMA*' or 'Request URL' like '*information_schema*' or 'Request URL' like '*WAITFOR DELAY*' or 'Request URL' like '*BENCHMARK(*' or 'Request URL' like '*SLEEP(*' or 'Request URL' like '*EXTRACTVALUE(*' or 'Request URL' like '*UPDATEXML(*')))
false_positives: Legitimate queries containing SQL keywords in search fields
Security scanning tools during authorized testing
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: WAF Web Shell Upload Attempt Blocked
rules.description: Detects attempts to upload web shell files blocked by WAF. Web shells provide persistent remote access through the web server. OWASP A03:2021 Injection.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'OCI WAF Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC WAF Security Logs') and (('Action' = 'BLOCK' and 'HTTP Method' = 'POST') and (('Request URL' like '*.php*' or 'Request URL' like '*.jsp*' or 'Request URL' like '*.asp*' or 'Request URL' like '*.aspx*' or 'Request URL' like '*.cgi*' or 'Request URL' like '*upload*' or 'Request URL' like '*file*')) and (('Request Body' like '*<?php*' or 'Request Body' like '*system(*' or 'Request Body' like '*exec(*' or 'Request Body' like '*passthru(*' or 'Request Body' like '*shell_exec(*' or 'Request Body' like '*eval(*' or 'Request Body' like '*base64_decode(*' or 'Request Body' like '*<%@ page*' or 'Request Body' like '*Runtime.getRuntime*' or 'Request Body' like '*ProcessBuilder*' or 'Request Body' like '*cmd.exe*' or 'Request Body' like '*/bin/sh*' or 'Request Body' like '*c99shell*' or 'Request Body' like '*r57shell*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: WAF XML External Entity Attack Blocked
rules.description: Detects XXE (XML External Entity) injection attempts blocked by WAF. Attackers exploit XML parsers to read files, perform SSRF, or execute denial of service.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'OCI WAF Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC WAF Security Logs') and (('Action' = 'BLOCK') and ( (('Request URL' like '*<!DOCTYPE*' or 'Request URL' like '*<!ENTITY*' or 'Request URL' like '*SYSTEM *' or 'Request URL' like '*file:///*' or 'Request URL' like '*expect://*' or 'Request URL' like '*php://filter*' or 'Request URL' like '*data://text*')) or ( (('Request Body' like '*<!DOCTYPE*' or 'Request Body' like '*<!ENTITY*' or 'Request Body' like '*SYSTEM *' or 'Request Body' like '*file:///*' or 'Request Body' like '*php://filter*')) and (('Content Type' like '*text/xml*' or 'Content Type' like '*application/xml*')) ) ))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Web Application Authentication Bypass
rules.description: Detects authentication bypass attempts including JWT manipulation, session fixation, and forced browsing to protected endpoints. OWASP A07:2021 Identification and Authentication Failures.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'SOC Web Application Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'OCI Load Balancer Access Logs') and ((('Attack Type' = 'authentication_bypass' or 'Attack Type' = 'jwt_manipulation' or 'Attack Type' = 'session_fixation' or 'Attack Type' = 'forced_browsing')) or ('OWASP Category' like '*Authentication*'))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Web Application Brute Force Login Attempt
rules.description: Detects repeated failed login attempts via HTTP 401/403 responses to authentication endpoints. Indicates brute force or credential stuffing attacks. OWASP A07:2021 Identification and Authentication Failures.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'OCI Load Balancer Access Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Load Balancer Access Logs') and ((('Request URL' like '*/login*' or 'Request URL' like '*/signin*' or 'Request URL' like '*/authenticate*' or 'Request URL' like '*/auth*' or 'Request URL' like '*/api/login*' or 'Request URL' like '*/api/auth*' or 'Request URL' like '*/token*' or 'Request URL' like '*/oauth*' or 'Request URL' like '*/portal/login*' or 'Request URL' like '*/vulnerable/login*')) and (('Response Code' = '401' or 'Response Code' = '403')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Web Application Privilege Escalation
rules.description: Detects privilege escalation attempts where users try to modify their role or access admin-only endpoints. OWASP A01:2021 Broken Access Control.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'SOC Web Application Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'OCI Load Balancer Access Logs') and ((('Attack Type' = 'privilege_escalation' or 'Attack Type' = 'role_manipulation' or 'Attack Type' = 'admin_bypass')) or (('Request Body' like '*"role":"admin"*' or 'Request Body' like '*"isAdmin":true*' or 'Request Body' like '*"role": "admin"*' or 'Request Body' like '*admin=true*' or 'Request Body' like '*role=admin*' or 'Request Body' like '*privilege=admin*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Web Application Server Error Spike
rules.description: Detects HTTP 500 Internal Server Error responses which may indicate successful injection attacks causing application errors, or application instability from attack traffic.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'OCI Load Balancer Access Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Load Balancer Access Logs') and ((('Response Code' = '500' or 'Response Code' = '502' or 'Response Code' = '503')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Web Application Session Hijacking Indicators
rules.description: Detects indicators of session hijacking or session fixation attacks where an attacker steals or manipulates session tokens. OWASP A07:2021 Identification and Authentication Failures.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'SOC Web Application Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'OCI Load Balancer Access Logs') and ((('Attack Type' = 'session_hijacking' or 'Attack Type' = 'session_fixation' or 'Attack Type' = 'cookie_theft' or 'Attack Type' = 'token_theft')) or ('OWASP Category' like '*Authentication*'))
false_positives: Session migration during load balancer failover
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Web Directory Enumeration Detected
rules.description: Detects directory and file enumeration attempts via high volume of 404 responses to common admin/config paths. OWASP A01:2021 Broken Access Control.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'OCI Load Balancer Access Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Load Balancer Access Logs') and (('Response Code' = '404') and (('Request URL' like '*/admin*' or 'Request URL' like '*/administrator*' or 'Request URL' like '*/wp-admin*' or 'Request URL' like '*/wp-login*' or 'Request URL' like '*/phpmyadmin*' or 'Request URL' like '*/phpMyAdmin*' or 'Request URL' like '*/.env*' or 'Request URL' like '*/.git*' or 'Request URL' like '*/.svn*' or 'Request URL' like '*/config*' or 'Request URL' like '*/backup*' or 'Request URL' like '*/db*' or 'Request URL' like '*/database*' or 'Request URL' like '*/debug*' or 'Request URL' like '*/console*' or 'Request URL' like '*/swagger*' or 'Request URL' like '*/api-docs*' or 'Request URL' like '*/actuator*' or 'Request URL' like '*/graphql*' or 'Request URL' like '*/graphiql*' or 'Request URL' like '*/server-status*' or 'Request URL' like '*/server-info*' or 'Request URL' like '*/robots.txt*' or 'Request URL' like '*/sitemap.xml*' or 'Request URL' like '*/crossdomain.xml*' or 'Request URL' like '*/.well-known*' or 'Request URL' like '*/composer.json*' or 'Request URL' like '*/package.json*' or 'Request URL' like '*/web.config*' or 'Request URL' like '*/Dockerfile*')))
false_positives: Web crawlers and search engine bots
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Web Server Process Spawning Command Shell
rules.description:
Detects a web server or scripting engine process spawning a command shell
(cmd.exe, powershell.exe, bash) with suspicious command-line arguments
containing pipe, semicolon, or other command injection characters.
This indicates successful Remote Code Execution (RCE) via the web application
(e.g., OS command injection in a FastAPI/Django/Express endpoint).
Covers MITRE ATT&CK T1059 (Command and Scripting Interpreter).
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Parent Process Name' like '*\\python.exe' or 'Parent Process Name' like '*\\pythonw.exe' or 'Parent Process Name' like '*\\python3.exe' or 'Parent Process Name' like '*\\node.exe' or 'Parent Process Name' like '*\\java.exe' or 'Parent Process Name' like '*\\javaw.exe' or 'Parent Process Name' like '*\\php.exe' or 'Parent Process Name' like '*\\php-cgi.exe' or 'Parent Process Name' like '*\\ruby.exe' or 'Parent Process Name' like '*\\dotnet.exe' or 'Parent Process Name' like '*\\httpd.exe' or 'Parent Process Name' like '*\\nginx.exe' or 'Parent Process Name' like '*\\w3wp.exe' or 'Parent Process Name' like '*\\uvicorn.exe' or 'Parent Process Name' like '*\\gunicorn')) and (('Process Name' like '*\\cmd.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\powershell.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\pwsh.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\bash.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\sh.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\wsl.exe')) and (('Command Line' like '*;*' or 'Command Line' like '*|*' or 'Command Line' like '*&&*' or 'Command Line' like '*||*' or 'Command Line' like '*`*' or 'Command Line' like '*$*' or 'Command Line' like '*/c whoami*' or 'Command Line' like '*/c id*' or 'Command Line' like '*/c cat*' or 'Command Line' like '*/c type*' or 'Command Line' like '*/c net*' or 'Command Line' like '*-enc *' or 'Command Line' like '*-EncodedCommand*')))
false_positives: Legitimate deployment scripts run by web frameworks
CI/CD build processes spawning shells from web hooks
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Web Server Process Spawning Shell with Injection Characters (Linux)
rules.description:
Detects a web application runtime (Python, Node, Java, PHP) spawning a shell
process (bash, sh, dash) with command-line arguments containing injection
characters (semicolons, pipes, backticks). This indicates successful Remote
Code Execution (RCE) via a command injection vulnerability in the web app.
Covers MITRE ATT&CK T1059 (Command and Scripting Interpreter) and
T1190 (Exploit Public-Facing Application).
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'SOC Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Secure Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Syslog Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Linux Audit Logs') and (((msg like '*ppid=python*' or msg like '*ppid=node*' or msg like '*ppid=java*' or msg like '*ppid=php*' or msg like '*ppid=ruby*' or msg like '*ppid=uvicorn*' or msg like '*ppid=gunicorn*' or msg like '*ppid=nginx*' or msg like '*ppid=httpd*')) and ((msg like '*exe="/bin/bash"*' or msg like '*exe="/bin/sh"*' or msg like '*exe="/bin/dash"*' or msg like '*exe="/usr/bin/bash"*' or msg like '*exe="/usr/bin/sh"*')) and ((msg like '*;*' or msg like '*|*' or msg like '*&&*' or msg like '*`*' or msg like '*$(*' or msg like '*whoami*' or msg like '*/etc/passwd*' or msg like '*/etc/shadow*')))
false_positives: Legitimate subprocess calls from web application deployment scripts
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Web Vulnerability Scanner Detected
rules.description: Detects known web vulnerability scanner user agents in Load Balancer access logs. Indicates active reconnaissance against the web application.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'OCI Load Balancer Access Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Load Balancer Access Logs') and ((('User Agent' like '*sqlmap*' or 'User Agent' like '*Nikto*' or 'User Agent' like '*nikto*' or 'User Agent' like '*Nessus*' or 'User Agent' like '*nessus*' or 'User Agent' like '*OpenVAS*' or 'User Agent' like '*w3af*' or 'User Agent' like '*DirBuster*' or 'User Agent' like '*dirbuster*' or 'User Agent' like '*Gobuster*' or 'User Agent' like '*gobuster*' or 'User Agent' like '*ffuf*' or 'User Agent' like '*feroxbuster*' or 'User Agent' like '*nuclei*' or 'User Agent' like '*Nuclei*' or 'User Agent' like '*Acunetix*' or 'User Agent' like '*ZAP*' or 'User Agent' like '*OWASP ZAP*' or 'User Agent' like '*Arachni*' or 'User Agent' like '*Skipfish*' or 'User Agent' like '*Burp Suite*' or 'User Agent' like '*Hydra*' or 'User Agent' like '*wfuzz*' or 'User Agent' like '*masscan*' or 'User Agent' like '*python-requests*' or 'User Agent' like '*Go-http-client*' or 'User Agent' like '*curl/*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: WiFi Password Extraction via Netsh
rules.description: Detects extraction of stored WiFi passwords using netsh wlan show profile with key=clear.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (('Process Name' like '*\\netsh.exe' and ('Command Line' like '*wlan*' and 'Command Line' like '*key=clear*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Windows Access Token Manipulation
rules.description: Detects access token manipulation techniques used for privilege escalation. Attackers steal or forge tokens to impersonate other users, especially SYSTEM or domain admin, without needing their credentials.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Command Line' like '*Invoke-TokenManipulation*' or 'Command Line' like '*token::elevate*' or 'Command Line' like '*token::revert*' or 'Command Line' like '*incognito.exe*')) or (('Command Line' like '*ImpersonateLoggedOnUser*' or 'Command Line' like '*DuplicateTokenEx*' or 'Command Line' like '*CreateProcessWithToken*' or 'Command Line' like '*SetThreadToken*' or 'Command Line' like '*AdjustTokenPrivileges*')) or (('Command Line' like '*JuicyPotato*' or 'Command Line' like '*SweetPotato*' or 'Command Line' like '*PrintSpoofer*' or 'Command Line' like '*GodPotato*' or 'Command Line' like '*RottenPotato*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Windows Account Discovery Commands
rules.description: Detects commands used to enumerate user accounts and groups in Active Directory. Attackers perform account discovery to identify privileged accounts, service accounts, and domain administrators for targeting.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (('Process Name' like '*net.exe' and ('Command Line' like '*user /domain*' or 'Command Line' like '*group /domain*' or 'Command Line' like '*localgroup administrators*')) or ('Process Name' like '*net1.exe' and ('Command Line' like '*user /domain*' or 'Command Line' like '*group /domain*')) or (('Command Line' like '*Get-ADUser*' or 'Command Line' like '*Get-ADGroup*' or 'Command Line' like '*Get-ADGroupMember*' or 'Command Line' like '*Get-LocalUser*' or 'Command Line' like '*Get-LocalGroupMember*')) or ('Process Name' like '*dsquery.exe'))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Windows Account or Group Enumeration Spike
rules.description: Detects repeated Security Event IDs 4798 and 4799, which can indicate adversary account or group membership enumeration.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Security Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Event Security Logs') and 'Event ID' in ('4798', '4799') | stats count as EnumerationEvents, unique('Target User Name') as Targets by User, 'Source Address', 'Host Name (Server)' | where EnumerationEvents > 3 | sort -EnumerationEvents
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Windows Administrative Share Access Spike
rules.description: Detects repeated Security Event IDs 5140 and 5145 against administrative shares such as C$, ADMIN$, and IPC$, which can indicate lateral movement or data harvesting.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Security Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Event Security Logs') and 'Event ID' in ('5140', '5145') and ('Share Name' like '*C$*' or 'Share Name' like '*ADMIN$*' or 'Share Name' like '*IPC$*' or msg like '*Share Name*') | stats count as ShareEvents, unique('Share Name') as Shares, unique('Relative Target Name') as Targets by User, 'Source Address', 'Host Name (Server)' | where ShareEvents > 2 | sort -ShareEvents
false_positives: Backup, software distribution, vulnerability scanning, or endpoint management activity
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Windows Admin Share Access via Net Use
rules.description: Detects access to admin shares (C$, ADMIN$, IPC$) for lateral movement.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Process Name' like '*\\net.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\net1.exe') and ('Command Line' like '*\\\\*' or 'Command Line' like '*$*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Windows AMSI Bypass Attempt
rules.description: Detects attempts to bypass the Antimalware Scan Interface (AMSI) through PowerShell commands or .NET reflection techniques.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Command Line' like '*amsiInitFailed*' or 'Command Line' like '*AmsiScanBuffer*' or 'Command Line' like '*amsi.dll*' or 'Command Line' like '*amsiContext*' or 'Command Line' like '*AmsiUtils*')))
false_positives: Security tool testing in lab environments
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Windows Audit Policy Changed
rules.description: Detects Event ID 4719, which records Windows audit policy changes that can reduce forensic visibility during an intrusion.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Security Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Event Security Logs') and 'Event ID' = '4719' | stats count as Changes by User, 'Host Name (Server)', Entity | sort -Changes
false_positives: Expected Group Policy or security baseline rollout windows
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Windows Backup Deletion via wbadmin
rules.description: Detects deletion of Windows backup catalog using wbadmin, preventing backup-based recovery.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (('Process Name' like '*\\wbadmin.exe' and 'Command Line' like '*delete*'))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Windows BITS Job Abuse for Persistence
rules.description: Detects abuse of Background Intelligent Transfer Service (BITS) for persistence or payload download. BITS jobs survive reboots and can notify on completion with arbitrary commands.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (('Process Name' like '*bitsadmin.exe' and ('Command Line' like '*/SetNotifyCmdLine*' or 'Command Line' like '*/SetNotifyFlags*' or 'Command Line' like '*/AddFile*' or 'Command Line' like '*/Resume*')) or ('Command Line' like '*Start-BitsTransfer*'))
false_positives: WSUS and SCCM using BITS for updates
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Windows Boot Configuration Modified
rules.description: Detects use of bcdedit.exe to disable recovery mode or modify boot configuration, commonly seen in ransomware attacks to prevent system recovery.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (('Process Name' like '*bcdedit.exe' and ('Command Line' like '*recoveryenabled no*' or 'Command Line' like '*bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures*' or 'Command Line' like '*safeboot*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Windows Certutil Download or Decode
rules.description: Detects usage of certutil.exe to download files from URLs or decode Base64 payloads, a common LOLBin abuse technique.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (('Process Name' like '*certutil.exe' and ('Command Line' like '*urlcache*' or 'Command Line' like '*decode*' or 'Command Line' like '*encode*' or 'Command Line' like '*-urlcache*' or 'Command Line' like '*-decode*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Windows Credential Dumping via Procdump
rules.description: Detects credential dumping attempts targeting the LSASS process using procdump or similar tools.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (('Process Name' = 'procdump.exe' and 'Command Line' like '*lsass*') or ('Command Line' like '*lsass.dmp*'))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Windows Credential Dumping via Secretsdump
rules.description: Detects execution of secretsdump.py or similar Impacket tools for credential extraction.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Command Line' like '*secretsdump*' or 'Command Line' like '*impacket*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Windows Credential Manager Access via VaultCmd
rules.description: Detects usage of VaultCmd.exe to enumerate or export Windows Credential Manager entries.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (('Process Name' like '*\\vaultcmd.exe' and ('Command Line' like '*/list*' or 'Command Line' like '*/listcreds*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Windows Data Staging for Exfiltration
rules.description: Detects data staging activity where an attacker collects and stages files before exfiltration. Indicators include copying files to temp directories, creating archives, or writing to removable media staging areas.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (('Process Name' like '*robocopy.exe' and ('Command Line' like '*/MIR*' or 'Command Line' like '*/E*' or 'Command Line' like '*/S*')) or ('Process Name' like '*xcopy.exe' and ('Command Line' like '*/S*' or 'Command Line' like '*/E*')) or (('Command Line' like '*C:\\Temp\\staging*' or 'Command Line' like '*C:\\Users\\Public\\*' or 'Command Line' like '*C:\\ProgramData\\staging*')) or (('Command Line' like '*compact /c*' or 'Command Line' like '*makecab*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Windows Defender Exclusion Added via PowerShell
rules.description: Detects addition of Windows Defender exclusions via PowerShell, often used to whitelist malware locations.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Command Line' like '*Add-MpPreference*' and 'Command Line' like '*-ExclusionPath*')))
false_positives: Developer adding build folders to exclusions
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Windows Defender Malware or Remediation Event
rules.description: Detects Microsoft Defender Antivirus operational events for malware detection, remediation, failed remediation, disabled protection, or configuration changes.
rules.oci_query: 'Log Source' = 'Windows Defender Operational Logs' and 'Event ID' in ('1116', '1117', '1118', '1119', '5001', '5004', '5007', '5010', '5012') | stats count as DefenderEvents, unique('Threat Name') as Threats, unique('Action') as Actions, unique('Status') as Statuses, unique('File Path') as FilePaths by 'Host Name (Server)', User, Entity | sort -DefenderEvents
false_positives: Authorized security testing or managed Defender configuration changes
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Windows Defender Real-Time Protection Disabled
rules.description: Detects commands disabling Windows Defender real-time protection via PowerShell or registry.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (( (('Command Line' like '*Set-MpPreference*' and 'Command Line' like '*-DisableRealtimeMonitoring*' and 'Command Line' like '*True*')) or (('Command Line' like '*DisableRealtimeMonitoring*' and 'Command Line' like '*1*')) ))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Windows DLL Side-Loading via Suspicious Path
rules.description: Detects execution of legitimate Windows binaries from non-standard paths, indicating potential DLL side-loading attacks where malicious DLLs are loaded alongside trusted executables.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Process Name' like '*rundll32.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*regsvr32.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*msiexec.exe')) and (('Command Line' like '*\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\*' or 'Command Line' like '*\\Users\\Public\\*' or 'Command Line' like '*\\ProgramData\\*' or 'Command Line' like '*\\Downloads\\*')))
false_positives: Legitimate DLL loading during software installation
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Windows Encoded PowerShell Execution
rules.description: Detects execution of PowerShell with encoded commands, commonly used to obfuscate malicious scripts.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (('Process Name' like '*powershell.exe' and ('Command Line' like '*-enc *' or 'Command Line' like '*-EncodedCommand*' or 'Command Line' like '*-ec *' or 'Command Line' like '*FromBase64String*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Windows Event Log Cleared via Wevtutil
rules.description: Detects clearing of Windows Event Logs using wevtutil.exe to remove forensic evidence.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (('Process Name' like '*\\wevtutil.exe' and ('Command Line' like '*cl *' or 'Command Line' like '*clear-log*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Windows Event Log Clearing
rules.description: Detects clearing of Windows event logs via wevtutil or PowerShell. Attackers clear logs to destroy evidence of their activities and hinder forensic investigation.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (('Process Name' like '*wevtutil.exe' and ('Command Line' like '*cl Security*' or 'Command Line' like '*cl System*' or 'Command Line' like '*cl Application*' or 'Command Line' like '*clear-log*')) or (('Process Name' like '*powershell.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*pwsh.exe') and 'Command Line' like '*Clear-EventLog*'))
false_positives: Legitimate log maintenance during disk space emergencies
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Windows Firewall Rule Modification
rules.description: Detects modification of Windows Firewall rules via netsh. Attackers disable or modify firewall rules to enable lateral movement or C2 communication.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (('Process Name' like '*netsh.exe' and ('Command Line' like '*advfirewall firewall add*' or 'Command Line' like '*advfirewall set allprofiles state off*' or 'Command Line' like '*advfirewall firewall delete*' or 'Command Line' like '*advfirewall firewall set rule*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Windows Kerberoasting Attack
rules.description: Detects Kerberoasting techniques using tools or PowerShell commands that request TGS tickets for service accounts to crack offline.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Command Line' like '*Rubeus*' or 'Command Line' like '*kerberoast*')) or (('Command Line' like '*Invoke-Kerberoast*' or 'Command Line' like '*Get-SPNUsers*' or 'Command Line' like '*Request-SPNTicket*')) or ('Process Name' like '*setspn.exe' and 'Command Line' like '*-Q */**'))
false_positives: SPN enumeration by service account management tools
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Windows Kerberos Pre-Authentication Failure Spike
rules.description: Detects repeated Kerberos pre-authentication failures through Event ID 4771, prioritizing bad-password, invalid-user, expired-ticket, and clock-skew result codes.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Security Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Event Security Logs') and 'Event ID' = '4771' and (Status in ('0x6', '0x12', '0x17', '0x18', '0x20', '0x25') or 'Failure Reason' in ('0x6', '0x12', '0x17', '0x18', '0x20', '0x25') or msg like '*Failure Code*') | stats count as Failures, distinctcount('Source Address') as UniqueSources by 'Target User Name', 'Source Address', 'Host Name (Server)' | where Failures > 3 | sort -Failures
false_positives: Password changes, expired credentials, or workstation clock skew
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Windows Keylogger Indicators
rules.description: Detects indicators of keylogging activity. Attackers deploy keyloggers to capture credentials, sensitive data, and user activity. Detects common keylogger tools, SetWindowsHookEx API calls, and suspicious input recording patterns.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Command Line' like '*keylogger*' or 'Command Line' like '*GetAsyncKeyState*' or 'Command Line' like '*SetWindowsHookEx*' or 'Command Line' like '*GetKeyboardState*' or 'Command Line' like '*MapVirtualKey*')) or (('Command Line' like '*logkeys*' or 'Command Line' like '*keystroke*' or 'Command Line' like '*keystrokes.txt*' or 'Command Line' like '*keylog.txt*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (('Process Name' like '*at.exe'))

false_positives: Legitimate usage of built-in Windows tools by administrators

false_positives: Legitimate WMI usage by management tools
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Windows LOLBin Usage: wscript
rules.description: Detects usage of Living off the Land binary wscript.
