false_positives: Legitimate usage of built-in Windows tools by administrators
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Windows LSASS Memory Access
rules.description: Detects tools accessing LSASS process memory for credential dumping. LSASS stores authentication credentials and is a primary target for credential theft.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (('Process Name' like '*rundll32.exe' and 'Command Line' like '*MiniDump*') or ('Process Name' like '*taskmgr.exe' and 'Command Line' like '*lsass*'))
false_positives: Memory dump for Microsoft support cases
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Windows Management Instrumentation Event Subscription
rules.description: Detects WMI event subscription creation for persistence via command-line WMI tools.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Command Line' like '*EventFilter*' and 'Command Line' like '*__EventConsumer*' and 'Command Line' like '*CommandLineEventConsumer*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Windows Mimikatz Execution Patterns
rules.description: Detects execution of Mimikatz or tools with Mimikatz-like command line patterns used for credential harvesting from Windows systems.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (('Process Name' like '*mimikatz.exe') or (('Command Line' like '*sekurlsa::logonpasswords*' or 'Command Line' like '*sekurlsa::wdigest*' or 'Command Line' like '*lsadump::sam*' or 'Command Line' like '*lsadump::dcsync*' or 'Command Line' like '*privilege::debug*' or 'Command Line' like '*token::elevate*')))
false_positives: Authorized penetration testing with documented scope
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Windows MSBuild Execution for Code Bypass
rules.description: Detects execution of MSBuild.exe which can compile and execute inline C# code from XML project files, bypassing application whitelisting and AppLocker policies.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (('Process Name' like '*MSBuild.exe'))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Windows Network Share Discovery
rules.description: Detects commands used to enumerate network shares. Attackers discover shared resources to identify sensitive data repositories, admin shares, and lateral movement paths.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (('Process Name' like '*net.exe' and ('Command Line' like '*share*' or 'Command Line' like '*view*')) or (('Command Line' like '*Get-SmbShare*' or 'Command Line' like '*Get-FileShare*' or 'Command Line' like '*Get-WmiObject Win32_Share*')) or (('Command Line' like '*SharpHound*' or 'Command Line' like '*Invoke-ShareFinder*' or 'Command Line' like '*Find-DomainShare*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Windows NTDS.dit Database Extraction
rules.description: Detects attempts to extract the Active Directory NTDS.dit database file using ntdsutil, vssadmin shadow copies, or direct copy commands. This file contains all domain password hashes.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (('Process Name' like '*ntdsutil.exe' and ('Command Line' like '*ac i ntds*' or 'Command Line' like '*ifm*' or 'Command Line' like '*create full*')) or (('Command Line' like '*ntds.dit*' or 'Command Line' like '*SYSTEM.hiv*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Windows NTLM Authentication Failure Spike
rules.description: Detects repeated NTLM validation failures through Event ID 4776, including bad password, bad username, disabled account, expired account, and lockout codes.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Security Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Event Security Logs') and 'Event ID' = '4776' and (Status in ('0xC0000064', '0xC000006A', '0xC000006D', '0xC0000072', '0xC0000193', '0xC0000234') or 'Failure Reason' in ('0xC0000064', '0xC000006A', '0xC000006D', '0xC0000072', '0xC0000193', '0xC0000234') or msg like '*Error Code*') | stats count as Failures, distinctcount('Source Address') as UniqueSources by 'Target User Name', 'Source Address', 'Host Name (Server)' | where Failures > 3 | sort -Failures
false_positives: Legacy applications retrying stored NTLM credentials
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Windows Pass-the-Hash Attack Indicators
rules.description: Detects command-line patterns associated with pass-the-hash attacks using tools like Impacket, CrackMapExec, or built-in Windows commands with NTLM hash parameters.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Command Line' like '*sekurlsa::pth*' or 'Command Line' like '*Invoke-SMBExec*' or 'Command Line' like '*Invoke-WMIExec*' or 'Command Line' like '*crackmapexec*' or 'Command Line' like '*smbexec*' or 'Command Line' like '*wmiexec*' or 'Command Line' like '*atexec*')) or ('Process Name' like '*runas.exe' and 'Command Line' like '*/netonly*'))
false_positives: Legitimate use of runas /netonly for cross-domain authentication
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Windows PowerShell Download Cradle
rules.description: Detects PowerShell download cradle patterns commonly used to fetch and execute remote payloads including Invoke-WebRequest, Net.WebClient, and Start-BitsTransfer.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Process Name' like '*powershell.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*pwsh.exe')) and (('Command Line' like '*Invoke-WebRequest*' or 'Command Line' like '*Net.WebClient*' or 'Command Line' like '*DownloadString*' or 'Command Line' like '*DownloadFile*' or 'Command Line' like '*Start-BitsTransfer*' or 'Command Line' like '*Invoke-RestMethod*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Windows PowerShell Suspicious Script Block
rules.description: Detects PowerShell Operational Event ID 4104 script blocks containing download cradles, AMSI bypass attempts, encoded payload handling, or Invoke-Expression execution.
rules.oci_query: 'Log Source' = 'Windows PowerShell Operational Logs' and 'Event ID' = '4104' and ('Script Block Text' like '*IEX*' or 'Script Block Text' like '*Invoke-Expression*' or 'Script Block Text' like '*DownloadString*' or 'Script Block Text' like '*FromBase64String*' or 'Script Block Text' like '*AmsiUtils*' or 'Script Block Text' like '*ExecutionPolicy Bypass*') | stats count as ScriptBlocks, unique('Script Block Text') as ScriptSamples, unique('Host Application') as HostApplications by User, 'Host Name (Server)', Entity | sort -ScriptBlocks
false_positives: Security automation and administrative PowerShell frameworks
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Windows Privileged Group Membership Changed
rules.description: Detects additions to privileged local, global, or universal groups through Security Event IDs 4728, 4732, and 4756.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Security Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Event Security Logs') and 'Event ID' in ('4728', '4732', '4756') and ('Target User Name' like '*Domain Admins*' or 'Target User Name' like '*Enterprise Admins*' or 'Target User Name' like '*Administrators*' or 'Target User Name' like '*Remote Desktop Users*' or msg like '*Domain Admins*' or msg like '*Administrators*') | stats count as GroupChanges, unique('Target User Name') as Groups by User, 'Host Name (Server)', Entity | sort -GroupChanges
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Windows Process Hollowing Indicators
rules.description: Detects suspicious process creation patterns indicative of process hollowing where a legitimate process is spawned in a suspended state and its memory replaced with malicious code.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Command Line' like '*CREATE_SUSPENDED*' or 'Command Line' like '*NtUnmapViewOfSection*' or 'Command Line' like '*ZwUnmapViewOfSection*' or 'Command Line' like '*WriteProcessMemory*' or 'Command Line' like '*NtResumeThread*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Windows PsExec Remote Execution
rules.description: Detects use of PsExec or similar Sysinternals tools for remote command execution, commonly used for lateral movement in compromised networks.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Process Name' like '*psexec.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*psexec64.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*PsExec.exe')) or ( (('Command Line' like '*psexec*' or 'Command Line' like '*\\\\\\\\*')) and ('Command Line' like '*-accepteula*') ))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Windows RDP Lateral Movement
rules.description: Detects use of mstsc.exe (Remote Desktop client) or enabling RDP via registry, indicating potential lateral movement between systems.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (('Process Name' like '*mstsc.exe' and 'Command Line' like '*/v:*') or ('Process Name' like '*reg.exe' and 'Command Line' like '*fDenyTSConnections*'))
false_positives: IT administrators using RDP for legitimate remote management
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Windows Registry Run Key Modification
rules.description: Detects modification of Windows Registry Run/RunOnce keys for persistence, allowing malicious programs to execute at system startup or user login.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Command Line' like '*CurrentVersion\\Run*' or 'Command Line' like '*CurrentVersion\\RunOnce*' or 'Command Line' like '*CurrentVersion\\RunServices*' or 'Command Line' like '*CurrentVersion\\Policies\\Explorer\\Run*')))
false_positives: Authorized registry modifications during software installation
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Windows Remote Access Tool Detected
rules.description: Detects installation or execution of remote access tools commonly abused by attackers. Tools like AnyDesk, TeamViewer, ngrok, and ScreenConnect provide persistent remote access that can bypass firewall rules.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (('Process Name' like '*AnyDesk.exe') or ('Process Name' like '*TeamViewer.exe') or (('Command Line' like '*ngrok*' or 'Command Line' like '*ngrok.exe*')) or ('Process Name' like '*ScreenConnect.ClientService.exe') or ('Process Name' like '*rustdesk.exe') or (('Command Line' like '*AnyDesk*' or 'Command Line' like '*TeamViewer*' or 'Command Line' like '*ScreenConnect*' or 'Command Line' like '*RustDesk*')))
false_positives: IT help desk using approved remote access software
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Windows Remote Management Shell via Winrs
rules.description: Detects usage of winrs.exe for remote command execution over WinRM.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (('Process Name' like '*\\winrs.exe' and 'Command Line' like '*-r:*'))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Windows Remote System Discovery
rules.description: Detects commands and tools used to discover remote systems on the network. Attackers perform network sweeps, ARP scans, and DNS lookups to identify targets for lateral movement.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (('Process Name' like '*arp.exe' and 'Command Line' like '*-a*') or (('Command Line' like '*for /l*' or 'Command Line' like '*ping -n 1*')) or ('Process Name' like '*nslookup.exe') or (('Command Line' like '*Test-Connection*' or 'Command Line' like '*Test-NetConnection*' or 'Command Line' like '*Resolve-DnsName*' or 'Command Line' like '*Get-ADComputer*')) or (('Command Line' like '*nbtscan*' or 'Command Line' like '*nbtstat -a*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Windows Scheduled Task Created or Updated
rules.description: Detects Security Event IDs 4698 and 4702 for scheduled tasks created or modified with suspicious task names or executable actions.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Security Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Event Security Logs') and 'Event ID' in ('4698', '4702') and ('Task Name' like '*Update*' or 'Task Name' like '*Cache*' or 'Command Line' like '*powershell*' or 'Command Line' like '*\\Temp\\*' or 'Command Line' like '*\\Users\\Public\\*' or msg like '*Task Name*') | stats count as TaskChanges, unique('Task Name') as Tasks, unique('Command Line') as Commands by User, 'Host Name (Server)', Entity | sort -TaskChanges
false_positives: Software deployment tools and endpoint management platforms creating scheduled maintenance tasks
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Windows Scheduled Task Creation via Schtasks
rules.description: Detects creation of scheduled tasks via schtasks.exe with suspicious patterns. Scheduled tasks are a common persistence and execution mechanism.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (('Process Name' like '*schtasks.exe' and ('Command Line' like '*/create*' or 'Command Line' like '*-create*')))
false_positives: Legitimate task scheduling by system administrators
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Windows Screen Capture Activity
rules.description: Detects screen capture tools and commands used by attackers to collect visual intelligence from victim systems. Screen captures can reveal sensitive data displayed on screen, credentials in open windows, and security posture.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Process Name' like '*SnippingTool.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*ScreenClippingHost.exe')) or (('Command Line' like '*nircmd savescreenshot*' or 'Command Line' like '*nircmd.exe savescreenshot*')) or (('Command Line' like '*[System.Drawing.Graphics]::CopyFromScreen*' or 'Command Line' like '*System.Windows.Forms.Screen*' or 'Command Line' like '*Screenshot*' or 'Command Line' like '*CopyFromScreen*')) or (('Command Line' like '*screencapture*' or 'Command Line' like '*screenshot.exe*' or 'Command Line' like '*capture.exe*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Windows Script Host Execution from Temp
rules.description: Detects cscript or wscript executing scripts from temporary directories.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Process Name' like '*\\cscript.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\wscript.exe') and ('Command Line' like '*\\Temp\\*' or 'Command Line' like '*\\tmp\\*')))
false_positives: Legitimate scripts running from temp during installations
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Windows Security or System Event Log Cleared
rules.description: Detects native Windows event log clearing through Security Event ID 1102 and System Event ID 104.
rules.oci_query: (('Log Source' = 'Windows Security Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Event Security Logs') and 'Event ID' = '1102') or ('Log Source' = 'Windows Event System Logs' and 'Event ID' = '104') | stats count as ClearEvents by User, 'Host Name (Server)', Entity | sort -ClearEvents
false_positives: Approved incident-response evidence collection or test system resets
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Windows Service Created with Suspicious Binary Path
rules.description: Detects creation of Windows services pointing to executables in user-writable paths.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (('Process Name' like '*\\sc.exe' and 'Command Line' like '*create*') and (('Command Line' like '*\\Temp\\*' or 'Command Line' like '*\\AppData\\*' or 'Command Line' like '*\\Users\\*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Windows Service Creation via SC
rules.description: Detects creation of new Windows services using sc.exe, which may indicate persistence or privilege escalation.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (('Process Name' like '*sc.exe' and 'Command Line' like '*create*'))
false_positives: Legitimate service installation during software deployment
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Windows Service Installed from Event Logs
rules.description: Detects service installation through System Event ID 7045 or Security Event ID 4697, with emphasis on service binaries in writable locations.
rules.oci_query: (('Log Source' = 'Windows Event System Logs' and 'Event ID' = '7045') or (('Log Source' = 'Windows Security Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Event Security Logs') and 'Event ID' = '4697')) and ('Service File Name' like '*\\Temp\\*' or 'Service File Name' like '*\\Users\\Public\\*' or 'Service File Name' like '*\\ProgramData\\*' or 'Service File Name' like '*powershell*' or msg like '*Service File Name*') | stats count as ServiceInstalls, unique('Service Name') as Services, unique('Service File Name') as ServiceBinaries by User, 'Host Name (Server)', Entity | sort -ServiceInstalls
false_positives: Legitimate software installation or endpoint management agent deployment
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Windows Shadow Copy Deletion
rules.description: Detects deletion of volume shadow copies via vssadmin or wmic, a common ransomware indicator to prevent recovery from encrypted files.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (('Process Name' like '*vssadmin.exe' and ('Command Line' like '*delete shadows*' or 'Command Line' like '*Delete Shadows*')) or ('Process Name' like '*wmic.exe' and 'Command Line' like '*shadowcopy delete*'))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Windows Spearphishing Attachment Execution
rules.description: Detects suspicious child processes spawned by Microsoft Office applications, indicating potential macro-based spearphishing payload execution. Office documents should not spawn cmd.exe, powershell.exe, or scripting engines.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Parent Process Name' like '*winword.exe' or 'Parent Process Name' like '*excel.exe' or 'Parent Process Name' like '*powerpnt.exe' or 'Parent Process Name' like '*outlook.exe' or 'Parent Process Name' like '*msaccess.exe')) and (('Process Name' like '*cmd.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*powershell.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*pwsh.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*wscript.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*cscript.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*mshta.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*regsvr32.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*rundll32.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*certutil.exe')))
false_positives: Legitimate Office add-ins that spawn processes
Office macros for approved business automation
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Windows UAC Bypass Attempt
rules.description: Detects common UAC bypass techniques including fodhelper, eventvwr, and sdclt abuse. These auto-elevate binaries can be hijacked via registry to execute arbitrary code with elevated privileges.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (('Process Name' like '*fodhelper.exe') or ('Process Name' like '*eventvwr.exe') or ('Process Name' like '*sdclt.exe' and 'Command Line' like '*/kickoffelev*') or ('Process Name' like '*cmstp.exe' and 'Command Line' like '*/au*'))
false_positives: Legitimate use of fodhelper for language settings
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Windows Vault Enumeration
rules.description: Detects enumeration of Windows Vault credentials using cmdkey or rundll32 with keymgr.dll.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (( ('Process Name' like '*\\cmdkey.exe' and 'Command Line' like '*/list*') or ('Process Name' like '*\\rundll32.exe' and 'Command Line' like '*keymgr.dll*') ))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Windows WDigest Authentication Enabled for Credential Harvesting
rules.description: Detects enabling WDigest authentication via registry modification. When enabled, plaintext credentials are stored in LSASS memory, making them available for extraction by tools like Mimikatz.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (('Process Name' like '*reg.exe' and 'Command Line' like '*UseLogonCredential*'))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Windows WMI Event Subscription Persistence
rules.description: Detects creation of WMI event subscriptions for persistence, allowing attackers to execute code triggered by system events.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Command Line' like '*__EventFilter*' or 'Command Line' like '*__EventConsumer*' or 'Command Line' like '*__FilterToConsumerBinding*' or 'Command Line' like '*ActiveScriptEventConsumer*' or 'Command Line' like '*CommandLineEventConsumer*')) or (('Command Line' like '*Set-WmiInstance*' or 'Command Line' like '*Register-WmiEvent*' or 'Command Line' like '*New-CimInstance -ClassName __*')))
false_positives: Legitimate WMI usage by management tools
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Winlogon Helper DLL Modification
rules.description: Detects modification of Winlogon helper DLL registry entries for persistence.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Command Line' like '*Winlogon*' and 'Command Line' like '*Shell*' and 'Command Line' like '*reg*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: WinRM Lateral Movement via PowerShell
rules.description: Detects WinRM-based lateral movement using PowerShell Invoke-Command or Enter-PSSession.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Command Line' like '*Invoke-Command*' or 'Command Line' like '*Enter-PSSession*' or 'Command Line' like '*-ComputerName*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: WMI Event Subscription Persistence
rules.description: Detects creation of WMI event subscriptions for fileless persistence.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Command Line' like '*ActiveScriptEventConsumer*' and 'Command Line' like '*__EventFilter*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: WMI Process Execution via Wmic
rules.description: Detects WMI-based process execution using wmic process call create.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (('Process Name' like '*\\wmic.exe' and ('Command Line' like '*process*' and 'Command Line' like '*call*' and 'Command Line' like '*create*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Wscript Running Encoded Script
rules.description: Detects execution of encoded VBScript or JScript files (.vbe, .jse) via wscript.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Process Name' like '*\\wscript.exe' or 'Process Name' like '*\\cscript.exe') and ('Command Line' like '*.vbe' or 'Command Line' like '*.jse' or 'Command Line' like '*.wse' or 'Command Line' like '*.wsf')))
false_positives: Legitimate encoded scripts from software vendors
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: XSL Script Processing via WMIC or Msxsl
rules.description: Detects execution of XSL scripts through WMIC /format or msxsl.exe for code execution.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and (( ('Process Name' like '*\\wmic.exe' and 'Command Line' like '*/format:*') or ('Process Name' like '*\\msxsl.exe') ))
rules.author: Upstream contributors

rules.name: Zerologon (CVE-2020-1472) Netlogon Exploitation
rules.description: Detects exploitation of the Zerologon Netlogon vulnerability (CVE-2020-1472), which resets the DC machine-account password to empty to seize the domain. Indicators include the public PoC tooling and mimikatz lsadump::zerologon. GOAD includes Zerologon as an attack path against the DCs.
rules.oci_query: ('Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Events' or 'Log Source' = 'Windows Sysmon Operational Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'SOC Windows Sysmon Logs') and ((('Command Line' like '*zerologon*' or 'Command Line' like '*cve-2020-1472*' or 'Command Line' like '*set_empty_pw*' or 'Command Line' like '*lsadump::zerologon*' or 'Command Line' like '*reinstall_original_pw*')))
rules.author: Upstream contributors
